dbef3411-8960-4e1c-9797-0d1668c8f4a9.label: LANGUAGE
dbef3411-8960-4e1c-9797-0d1668c8f4a9.def: SYSTEMATIC MEANS OF COMMUNICATING THROUGH THE USE OF SIGNS, GESTURES, WORDS, AND/OR AUDITORY SYMBOLS

edc187c7-a676-4190-98e3-077a1a333ad1.label: CIVIL STATUS
edc187c7-a676-4190-98e3-077a1a333ad1.def: A PERSON'S LEGAL RELATIONSHIP STATUS, SUCH AS SINGLE, MARRIED, CIVIL PARTNER, DIVORCED OR WIDOWED

002fe9e0-1b8a-4f07-a1da-62583c135f00.label: EDUCATIONAL TESTS
002fe9e0-1b8a-4f07-a1da-62583c135f00.def: TESTS TO DETERMINE LEVEL OF ACADEMIC ATTAINMENT OR PROFICIENCY IN RELATION TO A STANDARD MEASURE OF PERFORMANCE

11b817d2-80e5-4109-bb48-7985642809a0.label: EDUCATIONAL COURSES
11b817d2-80e5-4109-bb48-7985642809a0.def: THE ADMINISTRATIVE AND STRUCTURAL ASPECTS OF THE COURSE RATHER THAN THE SUBJECT CONTENT OR METHODOLOGICAL ASPECTS

00700b2f-5852-46a6-9d97-b58b974b8a91.label: FERTILITY TREATMENT
00700b2f-5852-46a6-9d97-b58b974b8a91.def: CLINICAL TREATMENTS AND PROCEDURES THAT AIM TO ADDRESS INFERTILITY

55eafa3d-ad9e-45d5-8d12-27ab27c48165.label: INFERTILITY (HUMAN)
55eafa3d-ad9e-45d5-8d12-27ab27c48165.def: INABILITY OF THE MALE OR FEMALE REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM TO ACHIEVE PREGNANCY

c395df5f-0901-41d3-bc2b-9a717745627a.label: STATUS IN EMPLOYMENT
c395df5f-0901-41d3-bc2b-9a717745627a.def: THIS TERM REFERS TO THE ALLOCATION OF AN INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS A PAID JOB TO ONE OF A SET OF CATEGORIES INDICATING THEIR RELATION TO THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION AND POSITION IN THE WORKPLACE HIERARCHY.

c1b6701f-2eac-47eb-98a7-445ef68d9431.label: LABOUR MIGRATION
c1b6701f-2eac-47eb-98a7-445ef68d9431.def: MIGRATION FOR PURPOSES OF SEEKING OR TAKING UP WORK

c0e62cb2-a471-4cbe-835f-7a31e2e5b4e0.label: NATIVE LANGUAGES EDUCATION
c0e62cb2-a471-4cbe-835f-7a31e2e5b4e0.def: CURRENT OR VERNACULAR LANGUAGE AND ITS LITERATURE

ff792293-af98-4a74-93d4-fa22d0e487b2.label: LANGUAGE SKILLS
ff792293-af98-4a74-93d4-fa22d0e487b2.def: COMPETENCY IN THE USE OF LANGUAGE OR IN THE ACQUISITION OF ADDITIONAL LANGUAGES

d9529eb7-bd85-4d0e-98f8-f83f87d5c969.label: HEALTH EDUCATION
d9529eb7-bd85-4d0e-98f8-f83f87d5c969.def: EDUCATION LEADING TO POST-SECONDARY QUALIFICATIONS AND/OR PREPARATION FOR CAREERS IN HEALTH PROFESSIONS

02891507-f1e3-4f48-9ca2-b18eb983625f.label: MEDICAL DIAGNOSIS
02891507-f1e3-4f48-9ca2-b18eb983625f.def: DETERMINATION OF THE NATURE OF A DISEASE BASED TYPICALLY ON THE ANALYSIS OF SIGNS OR SYMPTOMS, MEDICAL HISTORY, OR THE RESULTS OF LABORATORY TESTS

5723141a-6df3-4314-b9d4-967f571ae2f3.label: CENTRAL GOVERNMENT
5723141a-6df3-4314-b9d4-967f571ae2f3.def: THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF GOVERNMENT IN ANY COUNTRY.

02ebf3dd-516e-4943-b7a0-899683d6eec4.label: STUDENT UNIONS
02ebf3dd-516e-4943-b7a0-899683d6eec4.def: A UNION WHICH PROTECTS THE INTERESTS OF ITS STUDENT MEMBERSHIP

7f8c1f9a-7428-4bcc-9156-931be1b26591.label: INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
7f8c1f9a-7428-4bcc-9156-931be1b26591.def: THE WAYS GOVERNING BODIES, BUSINESSES, OTHER ORGANISATIONS, MILITARIES AND CITIZENS OF DIFFERENT NATIONS INTERACT, AND HOW THE EVOLVING DYNAMICS BETWEEN COUNTRIES IMPACT THESE INTERACTIONS.

42695df7-4e56-4c17-a078-9bdb534537f0.label: MINORITY LANGUAGE USERS
42695df7-4e56-4c17-a078-9bdb534537f0.def: THOSE WHOSE MOTHER TONGUE IS NOT THE MAIN LANGUAGE OF THE COUNTRY IN WHICH THEY LIVE

70d658bf-0bbb-4b9d-84e3-e6f9c081becc.label: AUDIO EQUIPMENT
70d658bf-0bbb-4b9d-84e3-e6f9c081becc.def: THIS TERM INCLUDES PLAYERS AS WELL AS RECORDERS.

d2e2cb33-98fb-46a4-bba3-6aa9b7394fbf.label: LITERACY
d2e2cb33-98fb-46a4-bba3-6aa9b7394fbf.def: THE ABILITY TO READ AND WRITE

865cf541-dcbc-4320-aab3-2fae74663e7c.label: RURAL AREAS
865cf541-dcbc-4320-aab3-2fae74663e7c.def: A CATEGORY OF LAND THAT HAS BEEN SUBSTANTIALLY MODIFIED BY DEVELOPMENT OF STRUCTURES, VEGETATIVE MANIPULATION, OR PASTORAL AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT

9a8349d8-3689-4fb0-ae32-47b769f1bd9f.label: SECOND LANGUAGES
9a8349d8-3689-4fb0-ae32-47b769f1bd9f.def: ANY LANGUAGES OTHER THAN ONE'S NATIVE OR MOTHER TONGUE, USUALLY LEARNED BY FORMAL LANGUAGE INSTRUCTION

0496e1ff-45e9-4ad4-a89b-3a04608049b4.label: TECHNOLOGICAL LITERACY
0496e1ff-45e9-4ad4-a89b-3a04608049b4.def: COMPREHENSION OF TECHNOLOGICAL INNOVATION AND THE IMPACT OF TECHNOLOGY ON SOCIETY -- MAY INCLUDE THE ABILITY TO SELECT AND USE SPECIFIC INNOVATIONS APPROPRIATE TO ONE'S INTERESTS AND NEEDS

629abbce-c794-4f63-a198-1abf7acfa2b2.label: DIGITAL LITERACY
629abbce-c794-4f63-a198-1abf7acfa2b2.def: AN INDIVIDUAL’S ABILITY TO USE DIGITAL INFORMATION AND RELEVANT TECHNOLOGIES TO FIND, EVALUATE, CREATE AND COMMUNICATE INFORMATION

5561860a-56ca-4849-a946-6e8de59bea7c.label: RITES
5561860a-56ca-4849-a946-6e8de59bea7c.def: A FORMAL PROCEDURE OR ACT IN A RELIGIOUS OR SOLEMN OBSERVANCE

b457babe-40a3-40cf-b113-6127a9e428cb.label: MARRIAGE CUSTOMS
b457babe-40a3-40cf-b113-6127a9e428cb.def: THE ESTABLISHED CUSTOM OF MARRIAGE IN A PARTICULAR SOCIETY, WHICH MAY NOT BE ACCEPTABLE OR USUAL IN OTHERS (FOR EXAMPLE, POLYGAMY)

a37b3bb7-6e0f-4201-a57a-574db3e59187.label: CUSTOMARY LAW
a37b3bb7-6e0f-4201-a57a-574db3e59187.def: A CUSTOM OR TRADITION, REASONABLE IN NATURE, THAT HAS BECOME LAW THROUGH BEING PRACTISED CONTINUOUSLY, AS IF IT WERE A RIGHT, SINCE THE BEGINNING OF LEGAL MEMORY

39653ab3-ea8a-411e-8fcf-3cf6db4d5114.label: POPULATION DYNAMICS
39653ab3-ea8a-411e-8fcf-3cf6db4d5114.def: THE DIFFERENCE IN THE SIZE OF A POPULATION BETWEEN THE END AND THE BEGINNING OF A GIVEN PERIOD

2a959e43-79b2-41cb-8ab9-78491a9e5926.label: OVERPOPULATION (HUMAN)
2a959e43-79b2-41cb-8ab9-78491a9e5926.def: AN UNSUSTAINABLY HIGH AMOUNT OF PEOPLE LIVING IN AN AREA. THE POPULATION IS TOO LARGE RELATIVE TO ITS RESOURCES TO MAINTAIN A DESIRED LEVEL OF DEVELOPMENT OR STANDARD OF LIVING.

4d00ab41-eb51-488a-b346-e1ebb8cd34c7.label: CIVIL PARTNERSHIP
4d00ab41-eb51-488a-b346-e1ebb8cd34c7.def: A LEGALLY RECOGNIZED RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN ADULTS THAT CARRIES THE SAME LEGAL RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS AS MARRIAGE

cd5294d6-7a5b-40d2-b08c-d6f467ba2d88.label: SPOUSES
cd5294d6-7a5b-40d2-b08c-d6f467ba2d88.def: THE HUSBAND OR WIFE WITHIN A MARRIED COUPLE

058276a2-3bfb-4016-8e3d-57635ed44c67.label: TECHNICAL EDUCATION
058276a2-3bfb-4016-8e3d-57635ed44c67.def: FORMAL EDUCATION, USUALLY AT SECONDARY LEVEL OR ABOVE, DESIGNED TO PROVIDE KNOWLEDGE ABOUT PRODUCTION PRINCIPLES AND PROCESSES AND THE PRACTICAL SKILLS NEEDED FOR PARTICIPATION IN PRODUCTIVE WORK

55bc754d-21df-4326-9dd5-af5950905358.label: OCCUPATIONAL STATUS
55bc754d-21df-4326-9dd5-af5950905358.def: EMPLOYMENT RANK, POSITION OR STATUS ACHIEVED BY AN INDIVIDUAL OR GROUP

0afa94bd-96fc-4d35-8a67-38ef37828f38.label: OCCUPATIONAL SOCIOLOGY
0afa94bd-96fc-4d35-8a67-38ef37828f38.def: SOCIOLOGY APPLIED TO THE WORLD OF WORK, E.G. THE WORKPLACE AS A SOCIAL SYSTEM, OCCUPATIONAL STATUS, INTERGROUP RELATIONS IN THE ENTERPRISE, ETC.

0f2f4063-5777-441d-bfa5-6a4b5ea80e91.label: OCCUPATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
0f2f4063-5777-441d-bfa5-6a4b5ea80e91.def: THE COMBINED APTITUDES AND SKILLS THAT PERMIT SOMEONE TO TAKE UP A JOB

fc21e5e3-f257-46b3-878d-693b3c7626d2.label: EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATION
fc21e5e3-f257-46b3-878d-693b3c7626d2.def: PLANNING, ORGANIZING, DIRECTING AND CONTROLLING HUMAN OR MATERIAL RESOURCES IN AN EDUCATIONAL SETTING; THE STUDY OF THIS PROCESS; AN ORGANIZATION WHICH CARRIES OUT THESE FUNCTIONS

b0732346-f434-4278-8b8d-225d8fd7e0e9.label: EDUCATIONAL ADMISSION AGE
b0732346-f434-4278-8b8d-225d8fd7e0e9.def: THE AGE OF COMMENCEMENT OF COMPULSORY EDUCATION; THE ACTUAL AGE AT WHICH A CHILD STARTS SCHOOL

06132244-23b0-4ad1-af62-39637c2507f7.label: MARRIAGE RATE
06132244-23b0-4ad1-af62-39637c2507f7.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF MARRIAGES TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF MARRIAGES PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

33a9c792-284b-4fe1-a57f-3ab140691e4f.label: MARRIAGE
33a9c792-284b-4fe1-a57f-3ab140691e4f.def: A LEGALLY RECOGNIZED RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN ADULTS THAT CARRIES CERTAIN LEGAL RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS

3ab99e06-4ec3-49c2-bf59-953464d598fc.label: INSTITUTIONS
3ab99e06-4ec3-49c2-bf59-953464d598fc.def: AN ESTABLISHMENT, ORGANIZATION, OR ASSOCIATION, INSTITUTED FOR THE PROMOTION OF SOME OBJECT, ESP. ONE OF PUBLIC OR GENERAL UTILITY, RELIGIOUS, CHARITABLE, EDUCATIONAL, ETC., E.G. A CHURCH, SCHOOL, COLLEGE, HOSPITAL, ASYLUM, REFORMATORY, MISSION, OR THE LIKE

1eeeff13-eaea-4f74-b169-9ccc8479c545.label: NATIONAL IDENTITY
1eeeff13-eaea-4f74-b169-9ccc8479c545.def: THIS TERM REFERS BOTH TO THE DISTINGUISHING FEATURES OF THE NATION (DISTINCTIVE TRADITIONS, CULTURE, LINGUISTIC OR POLITICAL FEATURES, ETC.), AND TO THE INDIVIDUAL'S SENSE OF BELONGING TO IT.

b09257e4-b304-4368-bad0-bf5d47d2b952.label: EDUCATIONAL POPULATION
b09257e4-b304-4368-bad0-bf5d47d2b952.def: NUMBER OF POPULATION ENGAGED IN EDUCATION. IT INCLUDES BOTH STUDENTS AND EDUCATIONAL PERSONNEL.

06b09611-0f44-4364-8c7d-05af926811c3.label: QUALITY OF LIFE
06b09611-0f44-4364-8c7d-05af926811c3.def: A SET OF OBJECTIVE STANDARDS AND SUBJECTIVE ATTITUDES BY WHICH SOCIAL, ECONOMIC, ENVIRONMENTAL AND HEALTH CONCERNS ARE ASSESSED

0722ed90-dfb8-46e0-8c96-37f1cc3d7337.label: WORK-LIFE BALANCE
0722ed90-dfb8-46e0-8c96-37f1cc3d7337.def: BALANCE BETWEEN TIME DEVOTED BY AN INDIVIDUAL TO PAID WORK IN RELATION TO TIME DEVOTED TO NON-WORK ACTIVITIES SUCH AS FAMILY OR HOME RESPONSIBILITIES, LEISURE OR ASPIRATIONAL ACTIVITIES.

30a2a62f-de0d-414e-a69c-4fc9f16458ee.label: PARENTAL LEAVE
30a2a62f-de0d-414e-a69c-4fc9f16458ee.def: PAID OR UNPAID LEAVE FROM WORK, TAKEN BY MOTHER OR FATHER, TO LOOK AFTER A CHILD OR MAKE ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE CHILD'S WELFARE

9371e415-d7e4-4a3c-9d55-4e8f42785589.label: HOURS OF WORK
9371e415-d7e4-4a3c-9d55-4e8f42785589.def: THE NUMBER OF HOURS EMPLOYEES ARE CONTRACTED TO WORK EACH WEEK FOR THEIR EMPLOYER

6ce3b4d2-f1a9-4ef8-bd99-09528c4afdf2.label: PUBLIC LAW
6ce3b4d2-f1a9-4ef8-bd99-09528c4afdf2.def: THE PART OF THE LAW THAT DEALS WITH THE CONSTITUTION AND FUNCTIONS OF THE ORGANS OF CENTRAL AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT, THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN INDIVIDUALS AND THE STATE, AND RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN INDIVIDUALS THAT ARE OF DIRECT CONCERN TO THE STATE. IT INCLUDES CONSTITUTIONAL LAW, ADMINISTRATIVE LAW, TAX LAW, AND CRIMINAL LAW.

5e9581cf-14f5-4cfa-80e2-4573a1c46d25.label: TRAVELLING PEOPLE
5e9581cf-14f5-4cfa-80e2-4573a1c46d25.def: THOSE FOR WHOM TRAVELLING IS A WAY OF LIFE, WHETHER OR NOT THEY HAVE A SETTLEMENT OR FIXED ABODE

07b7e948-08f1-48db-bb42-e0fa4bbd0ed6.label: SUBSTANCE USE
07b7e948-08f1-48db-bb42-e0fa4bbd0ed6.def: ANY SUBSTANCE TAKEN FOR ITS SUBJECTIVE EFFECT THAT MAY CAUSE UNEXPECTED TOXICITY

3f5bc5f0-7ca6-44e0-8f9a-f43911df76da.label: SOLVENT ABUSE
3f5bc5f0-7ca6-44e0-8f9a-f43911df76da.def: THE DELIBERATE INHALATION OF VOLATILE SOLVENTS TO PRODUCE INTOXICATION

5a2cadad-46bc-4b7b-bcdd-3f4eea61f5f0.label: READERSHIP
5a2cadad-46bc-4b7b-bcdd-3f4eea61f5f0.def: THE PEOPLE WHO READ OR ARE THOUGHT TO READ A PARTICULAR BOOK, NEWSPAPER, MAGAZINE, ETC.

25dc7d83-03a2-40b1-aa2c-7599abda4012.label: REDUNDANCY
25dc7d83-03a2-40b1-aa2c-7599abda4012.def: PERMANENT WORKFORCE REDUCTIONS AT THE ENTERPRISE LEVEL FOR ECONOMIC REASONS (E.G. BANKRUPTCY OR RESTRUCTURING) OFTEN AFFECTING A SIZEABLE NUMBER OF WORKERS

f8625e4b-756f-4374-83a3-3ed1cc3b7c24.label: LAY-OFFS
f8625e4b-756f-4374-83a3-3ed1cc3b7c24.def: FAILURE, REFUSAL, OR INABILITY OF AN EMPLOYER TO CONTINUE THE EMPLOYMENT OF AN EMPLOYEE ON ACCOUNT OF SHORTAGE OF RAW MATERIALS, POWER OR THE BREAKDOWN OF MACHINERY, ETC. LAY-OFFS ARE NORMALLY TEMPORARY AND WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO THE WORKER.

09024cae-6c94-4080-b1c1-3442d52fa697.label: IN-PERSON EDUCATION
09024cae-6c94-4080-b1c1-3442d52fa697.def: EDUCATION THAT TAKES PLACE WHEN TEACHERS AND STUDENTS ARE IN THE SAME PHYSICAL LOCATION AT THE SAME TIME

097b577e-af9e-4c51-8f8a-de7b65288390.label: GENDER EQUALITY
alt: EQUAL RIGHTS OF MEN AND WOMEN

3634c29c-6ddd-472d-9262-01153e31fe6a.label: WOMEN
3634c29c-6ddd-472d-9262-01153e31fe6a.def: PERSONS ASSIGNED A FEMALE SEX BASED ON PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS, OR WHO DEFINE THEMSELVES AS A WOMAN

a14e1fad-6496-4add-96ce-e8f973d15e1b.label: MEN
a14e1fad-6496-4add-96ce-e8f973d15e1b.def: PERSONS ASSIGNED A MALE SEX BASED ON PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS, OR WHO DEFINE THEMSELVES AS A MAN

09d0b153-3224-41e5-ba5b-2c0fe4647fa3.label: PSYCHOPATHOLOGY
09d0b153-3224-41e5-ba5b-2c0fe4647fa3.def: STUDY OF SIGNIFICANT CAUSES AND PROCESSES IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF MENTAL ILLNESS

0a6bc7c8-d457-4093-b6fe-befdf90652fc.label: INTELLECTUAL IMPAIRMENT
0a6bc7c8-d457-4093-b6fe-befdf90652fc.def: IMPAIRED INTELLECTUAL (IQ BELOW 70) AND ADAPTIVE FUNCTIONING MANIFESTED DURING THE DEVELOPMENTAL PERIOD

0ab9b6fb-5eef-476b-9005-68f6ef566caa.label: LIFE EXPECTANCY
0ab9b6fb-5eef-476b-9005-68f6ef566caa.def: THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF YEARS A PERSON IS EXPECTED TO LIVE, BASED ON STATISTICAL AVERAGES WITHIN A SPECIFIC POPULATION. IT IS INFLUENCED BY FACTORS LIKE HEALTHCARE QUALITY, LIFESTYLE, SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS, AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS.

0ad5a8b2-13ea-457c-82e9-9e8ad4ad02e9.label: SUBCULTURES
0ad5a8b2-13ea-457c-82e9-9e8ad4ad02e9.def: A GROUP OR CLASS OF LESSER IMPORTANCE OR SIZE SHARING SPECIFIC BELIEFS, INTERESTS, OR VALUES WHICH MAY BE AT VARIANCE WITH THOSE OF THE GENERAL CULTURE OF WHICH IT FORMS PART

2d7b6192-0c5f-4fdd-81cb-d9b719c4424a.label: NUMBER OF DIVORCES
2d7b6192-0c5f-4fdd-81cb-d9b719c4424a.def: NUMBER OF DIVORCES IN A POPULATON IN A GIVEN PERIOD

696a6b2e-01ff-4330-a003-d4cb3be5d906.label: BIRTH RATE
696a6b2e-01ff-4330-a003-d4cb3be5d906.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF LIVE BIRTHS TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF LIVE BIRTHS PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

715da575-f07a-4cae-ae19-1fe7aec06992.label: DIVORCE RATE
715da575-f07a-4cae-ae19-1fe7aec06992.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF DIVORCES TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF DIVORCES PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

7bbac201-fff2-4bb2-8766-84e671165f22.label: FERTILITY RATE
7bbac201-fff2-4bb2-8766-84e671165f22.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF LIVE BIRTHS TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF LIVE BIIRTHS PER 1,000 WOMEN OF REPRODUCTIVE AGE PER YEAR

acdfb412-a63f-4ff6-a371-db94edf733bb.label: NUMBER OF DEATHS
acdfb412-a63f-4ff6-a371-db94edf733bb.def: NUMBER OF DEATHS IN A POPULATON IN A GIVEN PERIOD

d8f31e43-68d0-4b17-a33e-9fee3c5f77b3.label: NUMBER OF BIRTHS
d8f31e43-68d0-4b17-a33e-9fee3c5f77b3.def: NUMBER OF LIVE BIRTHS IN A POPULATON IN A GIVEN PERIOD
narr: NUMBER OF BIRTHS OUTSIDE OF A MARRIAGE OR CIVIL PARTNERSHIP

dcd368c4-512d-4804-935f-bee93db0bf73.label: MORTALITY RATE
dcd368c4-512d-4804-935f-bee93db0bf73.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF DEATHS TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF DEATHS PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

ef0ea9b5-fc50-45fb-a84c-0182e5b51ab3.label: NUMBER OF MARRIAGES
ef0ea9b5-fc50-45fb-a84c-0182e5b51ab3.def: NUMBER OF MARRIAGES IN A POPULATON IN A GIVEN PERIOD

8da550e1-2d93-4f1d-89a6-7129f6bdc6ed.label: SINGLE PARENTS
8da550e1-2d93-4f1d-89a6-7129f6bdc6ed.def: PARENTS WHO ARE THE ONLY CARETAKER OF A DEPENDENT CHILD OR CHILDREN

60472fc5-2aa2-4bad-b1dc-fc3b7ee722be.label: PARENT PARTICIPATION
60472fc5-2aa2-4bad-b1dc-fc3b7ee722be.def: A PARENT'S INVOLVEMENT IN ALL/ANY AREAS OF THEIR CHILD'S LIFE, E.G. SCHOOLING, HEALTH, WELFARE

9211920d-99ef-4d2b-9b9f-a90c06fda560.label: PARENTAL ROLE
9211920d-99ef-4d2b-9b9f-a90c06fda560.def: THIS TERM COVERS THE SOCIAL, EMOTIONAL, ETC. ROLE OF PARENTS.

6f6941b4-e2bd-4ce5-b82c-75ff2e2f04f9.label: PRIMARY EDUCATION
6f6941b4-e2bd-4ce5-b82c-75ff2e2f04f9.def: ISCED LEVEL 1. THE CORE AT THIS LEVEL CONSISTS OF EDUCATION PROVIDED FOR CHILDREN, THE CUSTOMARY OR LEGAL AGE OF ENTRANCE BEING NOT YOUNGER THAN 5 YEARS OR OLDER THAN 7 YEARS. THIS LEVEL COVERS IN PRINCIPLE SIX YEARS OF FULL-TIME SCHOOLING.

0c2d1b34-272b-4264-aa9f-efa05a2c5ed4.label: STATE BUDGETS
0c2d1b34-272b-4264-aa9f-efa05a2c5ed4.def: A STATEMENT OF A GOVERNMENT'S PLANNED RECEIPTS AND EXPENDITURES FOR SOME FUTURE PERIOD, NORMALLY A YEAR. THIS IS USUALLY ACCOMPANIED BY A STATEMENT OF ACTUAL RECEIPTS AND EXPENDITURES FOR THE PREVIOUS PERIOD. A BUDGET SURPLUS MEANS THAT TOTAL GOVERNMENT RECEIPTS EXCEED TOTAL SPENDING; A BUDGET DEFICIT MEANS THAT SPENDING EXCEEDS RECEIPTS; AND A BALANCED BUDGET MEANS THAT INCOME AND SPENDING ARE EQUAL.

a0de2383-d76d-4585-9bd9-c16a4b5ce0ff.label: PESTICIDES
a0de2383-d76d-4585-9bd9-c16a4b5ce0ff.def: ANY CHEMICAL COMPOUND USED TO KILL PESTS AND INCLUDES HERBICIDES, INSECTICIDES AND FUNGICIDES

fa6e2bf7-7b28-49ee-badb-416b28a7adc7.label: REGIONAL POLICY
fa6e2bf7-7b28-49ee-badb-416b28a7adc7.def: THIS TERM REFERS TO REGIONS OR DISTRICTS WITHIN A COUNTRY.

0cb05fce-a58b-42bf-99b9-d8409deb2474.label: BISEXUALITY
0cb05fce-a58b-42bf-99b9-d8409deb2474.def: SEXUAL ATTRACTION TO PEOPLE OF BOTH SEXES BASED ON A BINARY OF FEMALE AND MALE

6e27a7e8-fdb0-4327-ba7a-08c5d0bccd23.label: SOCIAL SCIENCES, BUSINESS AND LAW EDUCATION

1e9b3402-2cbb-4ada-b24b-c668322b0b0f.def: ISCED LEVEL 4. PROGRAMMES THAT STRADDLE BOUNDARY BETWEEN UPPER-SECONDARY AND POST-SECONDARY EDUCATION FROM AN INTERNATIONAL POINT OF VIEW. TYPICALLY PROGRAMMES DESIGNED TO PREPARE STUDENTS FOR STUDIES AT LEVEL 5 WHO, ALTHOUGH COMPLETING LEVEL 3, DO NOT MEET THE LEVEL 5 ENTRY REQUIREMENTS FOR THE PARTICULAR COURSE THEY WISH TO TAKE E.G. PRE-DEGREE FOUNDATION COURSES, SHORT VOCATIONAL PROGRAMMES. IT HAS A TYPICAL FULL-TIME EQUIVALENT DURATION OF BETWEEN 6 MONTHS AND 2 YEARS.

77ae3d1f-2134-429e-bc81-bfd0c20ddce2.label: EDUCATIONAL LEVELS

9a6dfe11-88fc-4640-bdd6-842e39265d39.label: EXPATRIATES

eeee1de9-1dcb-488f-a60a-8c4b0a002094.label: HOME-BASED WORKERS

71d69142-4255-4696-9d52-414a38c95324.label: CAREERS GUIDANCE

ba79040a-dc40-4d19-9280-0d8b790ad1b3.def: THE TECHNOLOGIES OF COMMUNICATION THAT ENABLE THE INSTANTANEOUS TRANSFER OF INFORMATION BETWEEN DISTANT PLACES

2884bafb-6782-421d-982d-84684d718745.def: CONCERNED WITH THE PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF DISEASE AND DISABILITY, AND THE PROMOTION OF THE PHYSICAL AND MENTAL HEALTH OF THE POPULATION

3a1ea5a8-9106-4acb-8ac4-de43c09c106e.def: ILLNESS DUE TO BACTERIA OR TOXINS IN FOOD CONSUMED

d969cb30-93ff-4cc5-8782-e3cecbcbe63b.label: FOOD CONTAMINATION
d969cb30-93ff-4cc5-8782-e3cecbcbe63b.def: THE PRESENCE IN FOOD OF HARMFUL OR UNPALATABLE SUBSTANCES SUCH AS BACTERIA OR TOXINS

5e868e71-e887-4487-b79e-11cda0b34eff.label: EMIGRATION
5e868e71-e887-4487-b79e-11cda0b34eff.def: LEAVING A COUNTRY TO BECOME A RESIDENT IN ANOTHER COUNTRY

25666294-ca13-4901-8ec6-83612cb9b2d7.label: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION EDUCATION
25666294-ca13-4901-8ec6-83612cb9b2d7.def: THIS TERM COVERS ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION, CONTROL AND PROTECTION, AIR AND WATER POLLUTION CONTROL, LABOUR PROTECTION AND SECURITY.

2640c4e1-53a3-40be-8562-0998eb3a1b2f.label: BIRTH CONTROL
2640c4e1-53a3-40be-8562-0998eb3a1b2f.def: THE USE OF CONTRACEPTION METHODS OR STERILIZATION TO PREVENT CONCEPTION

658f74ac-e29a-49c6-9d55-50c67bb4805f.label: STERILIZATION (MEDICAL)
658f74ac-e29a-49c6-9d55-50c67bb4805f.def: COVERS BOTH MALE AND FEMALE STERILIZATION

272abcdb-2d53-4255-a0be-20b01fcceefe.label: EDUCATIONAL CERTIFICATES
272abcdb-2d53-4255-a0be-20b01fcceefe.def: CERTIFICATES AND OTHER DOCUMENTS CONFIRMING COMPLETION OF AN EDUCATIONAL COURSE, STREAM OF EDUCATION OR TRAINING PROGRAMME

ffdd3a7e-f82e-4600-98b1-20402e74b0a6.label: ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENT
ffdd3a7e-f82e-4600-98b1-20402e74b0a6.def: LEVEL OF ACADEMIC ATTAINMENT OR PROFICIENCY IN RELATION TO A STANDARD MEASURE OF PERFORMANCE, OR OF SUCCESS IN BRINGING ABOUT A DESIRED END

c60b48bf-80d4-4a4a-8a55-02b3ffc74546.label: CONGENITAL DISORDERS
c60b48bf-80d4-4a4a-8a55-02b3ffc74546.def: DISORDERS EXISTING AT BIRTH, WHICH MAY BE EITHER HEREDITARY OR DUE TO AN INFLUENCE OCCURRING DURING GESTATION UP TO THE MOMENT OF BIRTH

af47a332-514e-4e3b-a9ee-3c8dc64e8c56.label: COMPUTER SCIENCE EDUCATION
af47a332-514e-4e3b-a9ee-3c8dc64e8c56.def: THIS TERM COVERS COMPUTER SCIENCES AND SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT.

2d7d3835-7f12-422f-807f-d691786f919c.label: ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH
2d7d3835-7f12-422f-807f-d691786f919c.def: A BRANCH OF PUBLIC HEALTH CONCERNED WITH CORRECTING, CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF SUBSTANDARD ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS SUCH AS POOR WATER QUALITY, AIR POLLUTION AND POOR LIVING CONDITIONS

2cfdb82a-8f0c-44dd-9daa-96c75626e6f7.label: PREVENTIVE MEDICINE
2cfdb82a-8f0c-44dd-9daa-96c75626e6f7.def: THE BRANCH OF MEDICINE PRIMARILY CONCERNED WITH PREVENTION OF DISEASE AND PRESERVATION OF HEALTH IN THE INDIVIDUAL

913752e2-5c0e-4fe9-8c07-954b19a091c0.label: HEALTH POLICY
913752e2-5c0e-4fe9-8c07-954b19a091c0.def: THIS TERM INCLUDES PROVISION AND ORGANISATION OF HEALTH SERVICES AS WELL AS PUBLIC HEALTH POLICY ISSUES.

94feea64-93f8-40c3-acd0-23c197ff6421.label: INTERNATIONAL MIGRATION
94feea64-93f8-40c3-acd0-23c197ff6421.def: PEOPLE CHANGING THEIR USUAL PLACE OF RESIDENCE BY CROSSING NATIONAL BOUNDARIES

db45523c-70a5-41a6-9a17-392f9e468773.label: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION
db45523c-70a5-41a6-9a17-392f9e468773.def: THE DISTRIBUTION OF A POPULATION AMONG CATEGORIES DEFINED BY AGE, SEX, CIVIL STATUS, LOCATION, OR OTHER CHARACTERISTICS

a3b3e2be-74db-4030-9e94-9063018cfe7f.label: INTERNET USE
a3b3e2be-74db-4030-9e94-9063018cfe7f.def: THE MANNER, PURPOSE, FREQUENCY, ETC., OF THE USER'S INTERNET USE

32ce78ab-7d59-419c-8b83-328cb9ba049b.label: REFERENDUMS
32ce78ab-7d59-419c-8b83-328cb9ba049b.def: A DIRECT VOTE WHERE THE ENTIRE ELECTORATE OF A COUNTRY IS ASKED TO VOTE ON A SPECIFIC PROPOSAL OR ISSUE.

2a7cfe75-b5ec-43a8-b3e6-d789aa979d85.label: DIGITALIZATION
2a7cfe75-b5ec-43a8-b3e6-d789aa979d85.def: USE OF DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY IN ORDER TO CHANGE PROCESSES

2a8228cd-8dbc-4c4b-b3e5-cfe6a8824cef.label: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY
2a8228cd-8dbc-4c4b-b3e5-cfe6a8824cef.def: AN UMBRELLA TERM FOR ALL OF THE VARIOUS MEDIA EMPLOYED IN COMMUNICATING INFORMATION

7e8d4f62-1d5a-4e76-818d-fdcf60dcfcde.label: FAMILY PLANNING
7e8d4f62-1d5a-4e76-818d-fdcf60dcfcde.def: VOLUNTARY REGULATION OF THE SPACING AND/OR NUMBER OF BIRTHS IN A FAMILY - INCLUDES PROGRAMMES OR COUNSELLING TO ASSIST INDIVIDUALS OR COUPLES WITH SUCH PLANNING

2ab2390e-c0cb-43c7-a944-95b45ae1bd12.label: DEVELOPMENT AID (NATIONAL)
2ab2390e-c0cb-43c7-a944-95b45ae1bd12.def: DEVELOPMENT AID GIVEN WITHIN A COUNTRY'S NATIONAL BOUNDARIES

cb89d7b1-fbbb-4832-b911-e59fc6af4aae.label: NATURAL HERITAGE
cb89d7b1-fbbb-4832-b911-e59fc6af4aae.def: GENERALLY, THE WORLD'S NATURAL RESOURCES AS HANDED DOWN TO THE PRESENT GENERATION, AND SPECIFICALLY, THE EARTH'S OUTSTANDING PHYSICAL, BIOLOGICAL AND GEOLOGICAL FORMATIONS, AND HABITATS OF THREATENED SPECIES OF ANIMALS AND PLANTS AND AREAS WITH SCIENTIFIC, CONSERVATION OR AESTHETIC VALUE

2bfa2184-37ce-4f4e-9fea-7d85013c6fbf.label: MARRIAGE CONTRACTS
2bfa2184-37ce-4f4e-9fea-7d85013c6fbf.def: THE FORM AND SCOPE OF THE MARRIAGE CONTRACT DIFFERS WIDELY ACROSS CULTURES AND THROUGHOUT HISTORY. IN MODERN WESTERN CHRISTIAN CULTURE IT IS A LEGALLY RECOGNISED AGREEMENT BETWEEN A MAN AND WOMAN UPON THEIR MARRIAGE, EITHER IMPLIED BY THE MARRIAGE VOWS OR MORE FORMALLY DRAWN UP, AS IN A PRENUPTIAL AGREEMENT.

f95d4a93-4490-4a87-99c1-2e56da67191f.label: INCOME DISTRIBUTION
f95d4a93-4490-4a87-99c1-2e56da67191f.def: DIVISION OF A COUNTRY'S GNP AMONG ITS POPULATION

5948e553-f5a4-4d1a-8d29-9d42e42cba43.label: DRUG EDUCATION
5948e553-f5a4-4d1a-8d29-9d42e42cba43.def: EDUCATION AIMED AT INFORMING AND EDUCATING YOUNG PEOPLE ON THE CONSEQUENCES OF DRUG USE AND ABUSE

2cba7903-54ed-47dd-a398-d430f1568104.label: DISCRIMINATION ON THE BASIS OF SEXUAL ORIENTATION

c18a95e0-ba88-4e33-a3db-645a804600c0.label: HOMOSEXUALITY
c18a95e0-ba88-4e33-a3db-645a804600c0.def: SEXUAL ATTRACTION TO PEOPLE OF THE SAME SEX BASED ON A BINARY OF FEMALE AND MALE

b723921e-a61e-4620-b4d4-04a716b11ac0.label: MARRIED
b723921e-a61e-4620-b4d4-04a716b11ac0.def: REFERS TO PERSONS WHO ARE MARRIED

478bde4f-bedd-46ec-b84a-145d94f81973.label: DIVORCE
478bde4f-bedd-46ec-b84a-145d94f81973.def: THE CONCEPT OF DIVORCE OR INFORMATION ABOUT INDIVIDUAL DIVORCES

2dc633a5-382d-42ab-8e36-12f7c3dbb597.label: URBAN SPACES
2dc633a5-382d-42ab-8e36-12f7c3dbb597.def: INCLUDES MARKET PLACES, TOWN SQUARES, URBAN PARKS, PLAYGROUNDS, ETC.

532e2026-d631-4e6f-b808-2625cad8e55d.label: SOCIAL SECURITY
532e2026-d631-4e6f-b808-2625cad8e55d.def: STATE-ADMINISTERED MEANS-TESTED SYSTEMS OF INCOME MAINTENANCE THAT ARE INTENDED TO PREVENT PEOPLE FALLING INTO OR REMAINING IN POVERTY. SOME ARE CITIZENSHIP-BASED, OTHERS ARE RESIDENCE-BASED.

3211a00e-d4e2-45c4-aa1c-978ac9a1aebd.label: DEATH ALLOWANCES
3211a00e-d4e2-45c4-aa1c-978ac9a1aebd.def: A STATE BENEFIT TO COVER OR GO TOWARDS FUNERAL/BURIAL COSTS

a1ef2340-12b3-47f5-9847-c56ec61adb07.label: PARENTAL BENEFITS
a1ef2340-12b3-47f5-9847-c56ec61adb07.def: BENEFITS PROVIDED TO A MOTHER OR FATHER DURING PREGNANCY AND AFTER THE BIRTH TO CARE FOR THE CHILD. THEY INCLUDE PAID OR UNPAID LEAVE AND LUMP SUM PAYMENTS OF A MATERNITY OR CHILDBIRTH ALLOWANCE. THE BENEFITS VARY BETWEEN COUNTRIES WITH RESPECT TO THE AMOUNT OF LEAVE AND PAY/BENEFIT ENTITLEMENT, WHETHER ONLY ONE OR BOTH PARENTS HAVE ENTITLEMENT, AND WHETHER OR NOT THE BENEFITS ARE RESTRICTED TO EMPLOYEES. PARENTAL BENEFITS CAN ALSO APPLY TO ADOPTIVE PARENTS.

748af106-66b2-4a10-9e0c-073cab7c957f.label: DELIVERY (PREGNANCY)
748af106-66b2-4a10-9e0c-073cab7c957f.def: THIS TERM COVERS INFORMATION ABOUT METHOD OF DELIVERY, PLACE OF DELIVERY, AND DETAILS OF DELIVERY SUCH AS COMPLICATIONS OR TYPES OF INTERVENTION.

4539ceaf-2ba5-493e-8db3-37d00387db3d.label: MATERNITY CARE
4539ceaf-2ba5-493e-8db3-37d00387db3d.def: CARE PROVIDED DURING PREGNANCY (ANTENATAL CARE), DELIVERY, AND AFTER DELIVERY (POSTNATAL CARE).

c517c413-b8ec-4719-8f5d-1ea0ab01bd7c.label: ETHNOCENTRISM
c517c413-b8ec-4719-8f5d-1ea0ab01bd7c.def: REGARDING ONE'S OWN RACE OR ETHNIC GROUP AS OF SUPREME IMPORTANCE

8b0cc32b-a538-4e00-b86f-7016121f34d5.label: WRITING SKILLS
8b0cc32b-a538-4e00-b86f-7016121f34d5.def: SKILLS THAT ENABLE AN INDIVIDUAL TO WRITE LUCIDLY, COHERENTLY, AND GRAMMATICALLY, OR TO HANDWRITE LEGIBLY WITH EASE AND SPEED

30da54cb-9f10-4b11-b107-4fe0205e76e3.label: SCHOOL-LEAVING AGE
30da54cb-9f10-4b11-b107-4fe0205e76e3.def: THE AGE AT WHICH A PERSON CAN LEGALLY LEAVE COMPULSORY EDUCATION; THE ACTUAL AGE AT WHICH A PERSON LEAVES SCHOOL

310eba0d-5522-4207-9069-d2a1a7423360.label: GENDER IDENTITY
310eba0d-5522-4207-9069-d2a1a7423360.def: ONE'S INNERMOST CONCEPT OF SELF AS MALE, FEMALE, A BLEND OF BOTH OR NEITHER – HOW INDIVIDUALS PERCEIVE THEMSELVES AND WHAT THEY CALL THEMSELVES

3bb992d6-f232-4d30-be23-5e846e701b91.label: BIGENDER PERSONS
3bb992d6-f232-4d30-be23-5e846e701b91.def: PEOPLE WHO HAVE TWO GENDER IDENTITIES, EITHER SIMULTANEOUSLY OR ALTERNATELY

57c17efe-0e95-4caa-9df1-40401907c373.label: AGENDER PERSONS
57c17efe-0e95-4caa-9df1-40401907c373.def: PEOPLE WHO DO NOT CONSIDER THAT THEY BELONG TO ANY PARTICULAR GENDER

dacafa32-05af-49b3-8511-898c283b14d7.label: GENDERQUEER PERSONS
dacafa32-05af-49b3-8511-898c283b14d7.def: PERSONS WHOSE GENDER IDENTITY IS NEITHER MAN NOR WOMAN, IS BETWEEN OR BEYOND GENDERS, OR IS SOME COMBINATION OF GENDERS

dc826eb2-2251-4876-99c0-6749c8139033.label: TRANSGENDER PERSONS
dc826eb2-2251-4876-99c0-6749c8139033.def: PEOPLE WHOSE GENDER IDENTITY IS DIFFERENT FROM THEIR ASSIGNED SEX AT BIRTH

ecec9894-af02-4023-9a47-291e1507a4eb.label: NON-BINARY PERSONS
ecec9894-af02-4023-9a47-291e1507a4eb.def: PERSONS EXPERIENCING A GENDER IDENTITY THAT IS NEITHER ENTIRELY MALE NOR ENTIRELY FEMALE. THEIR IDENTITY MAY BE A MIX OF GENDERS OR OF NO GENDER AT ALL.

884a2cea-8c90-4570-9677-9259fc5b0faa.label: PRE-PRIMARY EDUCATION
884a2cea-8c90-4570-9677-9259fc5b0faa.def: ISCED LEVEL 0. THE INITIAL STAGE OF ORGANIZED INSTRUCTION, TAKING PLACE IN A SCHOOL-BASED OR CENTRE-BASED ENVIRONMENT. DESIGNED PRIMARILY TO INTRODUCE VERY YOUNG CHILDREN TO A SCHOOL-TYPE ENVIRONMENT. ENTRY AGE IS FOR CHILDREN AGED AT LEAST 3 YEARS WITH THE UPPER AGE LIMIT DEPENDENT ON THE TYPICAL AGE FOR ENTRY INTO PRIMARY EDUCATION.

36e0ece6-2a25-4c77-81d5-3975535117c0.label: COMMUNITY CENTRES
36e0ece6-2a25-4c77-81d5-3975535117c0.def: LOCAL CENTRES FOR ALL KINDS OF ACADEMIC AND RECREATIONAL ACTIVITIES

7c9b8b91-ac23-4730-8606-b3b1a285ece0.label: INFIDELITY
7c9b8b91-ac23-4730-8606-b3b1a285ece0.def: SEXUAL RELATIONS OUTSIDE A MARRIAGE OR ESTABLISHED RELATIONSHIP BY EITHER ONE OF THE PARTIES TO THAT RELATIONSHIP

cfa2ba08-3da3-4a2b-ac34-919b60d31ba1.label: PARTNERSHIP HISTORY (PERSONAL)
cfa2ba08-3da3-4a2b-ac34-919b60d31ba1.def: HISTORY OF COHABITATION, MARRIAGE AND CIVIL PARTNERSHIPS

617266ca-454a-4844-87d3-9f125b7ea8c6.label: FAMILY POLICY
617266ca-454a-4844-87d3-9f125b7ea8c6.def: POLITICAL DECISIONS THAT AFFECT THE LIVES OF FAMILIES (WITH CHILDREN) AND HOW MANY CHILDREN PEOPLE MAY WANT TO HAVE

58e330fe-5b6d-4a25-9bcb-700d9e150b12.label: SOCIAL NEEDS
58e330fe-5b6d-4a25-9bcb-700d9e150b12.def: THE SOCIAL NEEDS OF A PARTICULAR INDIVIDUAL, COMMUNITY OR SOCIETY, WHICH MAY INCLUDE HOUSING, EMPLOYMENT, SOCIAL INCLUSION, ETC.

db8a9a53-6b90-4a01-9e16-dfefe986a364.label: ASSOCIATIONS
db8a9a53-6b90-4a01-9e16-dfefe986a364.def: A BODY OF PERSONS WHO HAVE COMBINED TO EXECUTE A COMMON PURPOSE OR ADVANCE A COMMON CAUSE; TYPICALLY, BUT NOT NECESSARILY, GOVERNED BY A COMMITTEE DRAWN FROM THE MEMBERSHIP

9b164533-8c1c-4e6c-8fe2-7625f7efe10f.label: SOCIAL SANCTIONS
9b164533-8c1c-4e6c-8fe2-7625f7efe10f.def: SOCIAL CONTROLS OR PUNISHMENTS, SUCH AS THE THREAT OF DISAPPROVAL, EXERCISED BY SOCIETY TO ENSURE CONFORMITY; STIGMATIZATION OF THOSE WHO TRANSGRESS SOCIAL NORMS

3499d5c3-99a7-45ee-b8aa-113e153b6727.label: CHILD SUPPORT PAYMENTS
3499d5c3-99a7-45ee-b8aa-113e153b6727.def: PAYMENTS MADE BY AN ABSENT PARENT TO CONTRIBUTE TOWARDS SUPPORT OF A MINOR CHILD, EITHER BY MEANS OF A LEGALLY ENFORCED PROCEDURE OR BY A VOLUNTARY AGREEMENT (TYPICALLY FOLLOWING DIVORCE OR SEPARATION)

7ab9034d-8a1d-49aa-a8af-798317fccd31.label: FINANCIAL SUPPORT
7ab9034d-8a1d-49aa-a8af-798317fccd31.def: REFERS TO FINANCIAL AID AT A PERSONAL LEVEL

e5ad29e7-f125-428f-8437-567d8ab5700c.label: ARMIES
e5ad29e7-f125-428f-8437-567d8ab5700c.def: THE REGULAR TROOPS OR LAND FORCES OF A STATE

a8766bb7-26f4-47b5-baf8-1028b4c58d76.label: GROUP BEHAVIOUR
a8766bb7-26f4-47b5-baf8-1028b4c58d76.def: BEHAVIOUR OF MEMBERS OF A GROUP, THAT WOULD NOT OCCUR WERE THEY ACTING INDEPENDENTLY

fbf1de52-ba32-439a-94e4-1249934751b6.label: CHILD LABOUR
fbf1de52-ba32-439a-94e4-1249934751b6.def: WORK CARRIED OUT BY CHILDREN OF SCHOOL AGE, USUALLY PART-TIME

61681f50-c081-4f3f-aac3-3208c92c879e.label: FEMININITY
61681f50-c081-4f3f-aac3-3208c92c879e.def: A SET OF ATTRIBUTES, BEHAVIOURS, AND ROLES GENERALLY ASSOCIATED WITH GIRLS AND WOMEN

5ce975a2-714c-4529-8a3d-7412dadfa117.label: LABOUR RELATIONS
5ce975a2-714c-4529-8a3d-7412dadfa117.def: THE RELATIONS BETWEEN MANAGEMENT AND LABOUR

367b11df-df30-4a4a-b5d4-733b69da5f53.label: REPATRIATION (HUMAN)
367b11df-df30-4a4a-b5d4-733b69da5f53.def: THE VOLUNTARY OR INVOLUNTARY PROCESS OF RETURNING A PERSON TO THE COUNTRY OF ORIGIN, ALLEGIANCE, OR CITIZENSHIP

5db94191-315e-4f6a-92c2-2caa5c0e020f.label: EXTENDED FAMILY
5db94191-315e-4f6a-92c2-2caa5c0e020f.def: AN EXTENSIVE GROUP OF PEOPLE WHO ARE RELATED BY BLOOD OR MARRIAGE OR WHO OTHERWISE REGARD THEMSELVES AS A LARGE FAMILY

66e7ffc5-5dd5-4acc-a001-59b958ed5a04.label: SINGLE-PARENT FAMILIES
66e7ffc5-5dd5-4acc-a001-59b958ed5a04.def: FAMILIES THAT INCLUDE A CHILD OR CHILDREN AND ARE HEADED BY A SINGLE PARENT

cae60b4a-9d0b-4ac2-b2d4-e6c17c2dea03.label: FAMILY LIFE
cae60b4a-9d0b-4ac2-b2d4-e6c17c2dea03.def: THE DYNAMICS OF INTERPERSONAL INTERACTION BETWEEN MEMBERS OF A FAMILY UNIT

6fc491c5-ca3f-4304-ae64-d3a8a9ff415a.label: PSYCHOMETRICS
6fc491c5-ca3f-4304-ae64-d3a8a9ff415a.def: THE SCIENCE OF MEASURING MENTAL CAPACITIES AND PROCESSES; THE APPLICATION OF METHODS OF MEASUREMENT TO THE VARIOUS BRANCHES OF PSYCHOLOGY

451e60a2-0ff3-431b-a296-0a11887a3de6.label: EDUCATIONAL ADMINISTRATORS
451e60a2-0ff3-431b-a296-0a11887a3de6.def: SENIOR SCHOOL, COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY OFFICERS

af18c478-a424-4e7d-8e00-3efdd649f7d1.label: TEACHING ASSISTANTS (SCHOOLS)
af18c478-a424-4e7d-8e00-3efdd649f7d1.def: THOSE WHO SUPPORT THE WORK OF THE TEACHER IN THE CLASSROOM IN A VARIETY OF ROLES, SOMETIMES HELPING CHILDREN WITH SPECIAL EDUCATIONAL NEEDS AND DISABILITIES. THEY MAY NOT NECESSARILY HAVE FORMAL QUALIFICATIONS.

8adc1e21-f3bb-4097-9ed1-3d695302f796.label: EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION BUDGETS
8adc1e21-f3bb-4097-9ed1-3d695302f796.def: REFERS TO BUDGETS WITHIN INDIVIDUAL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS

c4cb3540-d9a3-4e1e-a3da-c5ab7ef4e7db.label: ECONOMIC ACTIVITY
c4cb3540-d9a3-4e1e-a3da-c5ab7ef4e7db.def: THIS TERM IS USED TO COVER BOTH PEOPLE WHO ARE ECONOMICALLY ACTIVE (IN THE LABOUR FORCE) AND PEOPLE WHO ARE ECONOMICALLY INACTIVE (NOT IN THE LABOUR FORCE).

acadffb8-274f-41c4-b60e-9162edc356d8.label: SECONDARY SCHOOLS
acadffb8-274f-41c4-b60e-9162edc356d8.def: THIS TERM IS MAINLY USED FOR THE UK EDUCATIONAL SYSTEMS. IT COVERS ISCED LEVELS 2 AND 3.

8a01cbce-5c13-4115-9cb8-a80f3c5dfe08.label: AGEING POPULATION
8a01cbce-5c13-4115-9cb8-a80f3c5dfe08.def: AN INCREASE IN THE PROPORTION OF OLDER PEOPLE IN THE TOTAL POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD

9db0cd4c-64a3-4c78-94c2-8a8a3b61db3d.label: POPULATION GROWTH
9db0cd4c-64a3-4c78-94c2-8a8a3b61db3d.def: AN INCREASE IN THE NUMBER OF PERSONS IN A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD

e0a55e2c-c58e-46c2-8cdc-fb9c4a7b00a9.label: POPULATION DECREASE
e0a55e2c-c58e-46c2-8cdc-fb9c4a7b00a9.def: A DECREASE IN THE NUMBER OF PERSONS IN A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD

4b6259ab-d7eb-41f3-bf1c-65d9ec4627c0.label: INFORMAL ECONOMY
4b6259ab-d7eb-41f3-bf1c-65d9ec4627c0.def: THE UNOFFICIAL OR UNRECORDED AND UNTAXED SECTOR OF THE ECONOMY

bf0396e7-65ed-455e-af79-e30b0211a910.label: EDUCATIONAL INTEGRATION
bf0396e7-65ed-455e-af79-e30b0211a910.def: INTEGRATION OF STUDENTS IN EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS REGARDLESS OF MENTAL OR PHYSICAL ABILITY, RELIGION, SEX OR ETHNIC IDENTITY

b6fe5a92-43db-4d98-b31b-d36a8fb8e1a7.label: EDUCATIONALLY DISADVANTAGED
narr: STUDENTS WITH SPECIAL EDUCATIONAL NEEDS AND DISABILITIES

d3b9e319-144b-4b46-bc87-ac2ff7fd41ac.label: ZOONOTIC DISEASES
d3b9e319-144b-4b46-bc87-ac2ff7fd41ac.def: INFECTIONS OR INFESTATIONS SHARED IN NATURE BY HUMANS AND OTHER ANIMALS THAT ARE THE NORMAL OR USUAL HOST. A ZOONOTIC AGENT MAY BE A BACTERIUM, VIRUS, FUNGUS, PARASITE, OR OTHER COMMUNICABLE AGENT.

3d92431b-b64d-4266-a464-e3461df55e5d.label: RESIDENTIAL MOBILITY
3d92431b-b64d-4266-a464-e3461df55e5d.def: MOVING FROM ONE RESIDENCE TO ANOTHER

cfc2f59a-a46e-4f8a-9a4a-8a63b78088d7.label: ANTENATAL DIAGNOSTIC TESTS
cfc2f59a-a46e-4f8a-9a4a-8a63b78088d7.def: TESTS CARRIED OUT DURING PREGNANCY TO HELP DIAGNOSE CONGENITAL DISEASES OR ABNORMALITIES IN THE FOETUS. THESE MAY INCLUDE BLOOD TESTS, ULTRASOUND SCANS OR AMNIOCENTESIS.

cc132436-fdc6-4611-920b-cd8bb4e48aa2.label: RURAL-URBAN MIGRATION
cc132436-fdc6-4611-920b-cd8bb4e48aa2.def: POPULATION MIGRATION FROM RURAL TO URBAN AREAS

af45710b-f5ea-4ac1-a6cc-682a50b3fa67.label: BASIC NEEDS
af45710b-f5ea-4ac1-a6cc-682a50b3fa67.def: THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS FOR A DECENT STANDARD OF LIFE: ADEQUATE FOOD, SHELTER, CLOTHING, COMMUNITY SERVICES. THEY ALSO INCLUDE NEEDS RELATING TO HUMAN RIGHTS, PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN DECISION-MAKING, PRODUCTIVE EMPLOYMENT.

b5d0dc40-78a3-441a-ae24-eb1079f5ec1b.label: RESIDENTS OF INSTITUTIONS
b5d0dc40-78a3-441a-ae24-eb1079f5ec1b.def: PEOPLE LIVING IN NON-PRIVATE HOUSEHOLDS, E.G. HOMES FOR THE ELDERLY OR DISABLED, STUDENTS' HALLS OF RESIDENCE, PRISONS, ETC.

8ca2b108-3d08-4f1e-b3cf-2e78a256347d.label: FOOD SHORTAGES
8ca2b108-3d08-4f1e-b3cf-2e78a256347d.def: A FOOD SHORTAGE HAPPENS WHEN AN AREA, COUNTRY OR REGION DOES NOT HAVE ENOUGH (NUTRITIOUS) FOOD FOR ITS POPULATION, TYPICALLY BECAUSE OF PRODUCTION ISSUES WHERE NOT ENOUGH FOOD IS GROWN OR IMPORTED TO MEET A POPULATION’S NUTRIENT REQUIREMENTS

41977681-54f0-4d0a-aca8-8cb8f116db07.label: SINGLE MOTHERS
41977681-54f0-4d0a-aca8-8cb8f116db07.def: MOTHERS WHO ARE THE ONLY CARETAKER OF A DEPENDENT CHILD OR CHILDREN

f39262fa-a2ba-44a8-a0a0-cf489232f10e.label: SINGLES (CIVIL STATUS)
f39262fa-a2ba-44a8-a0a0-cf489232f10e.def: PERSONS WHO HAVE NEVER BEEN IN A LEGAL UNION

ac1b6a31-2fe2-4481-a0b4-ab945326fc69.label: LANGUAGE VARIATIONS
ac1b6a31-2fe2-4481-a0b4-ab945326fc69.def: DIFFERENCES IN SYSTEMS OF A LANGUAGE THAT RESULT FROM HISTORICAL, GEOGRAPHICAL, SOCIAL OR FUNCTIONAL CHANGES

b06d3a6d-ec7c-4a17-90e1-c66112437e5f.label: MOTHER TONGUE
b06d3a6d-ec7c-4a17-90e1-c66112437e5f.def: A LANGUAGE THAT PEOPLE HAVE ACQUIRED NATURALLY AS CHILDREN, AS OPPOSED TO ONE LEARNED LATER, E.G. THROUGH FORMAL EDUCATION

93c92122-f93f-48de-b89d-3fdcc3678fac.label: FURTHER EDUCATION
93c92122-f93f-48de-b89d-3fdcc3678fac.def: POST-SECONDARY EDUCATION LEADING, USUALLY, TO QUALIFICATIONS AT SUB-DEGREE LEVEL, THOUGH IT MAY NOT LEAD TO ANY AWARD AT ALL BUT SIMPLY BE TAKEN FOR ITS OWN SAKE

436aaebf-5594-4bbc-a7b8-07591ca3dd89.label: CRIMES AGAINST HUMANITY
436aaebf-5594-4bbc-a7b8-07591ca3dd89.def: OFFENCES CONSIDERED TO BE OF SUCH A MAGNITUDE THAT ARE ANSWERABLE TO THE WHOLE OF HUMANITY AND NOT TO A SPECIFIC JURISDICTION

ca2ea77a-9963-4085-b2ad-cf0f599c5ff1.label: ELDER ABUSE
ca2ea77a-9963-4085-b2ad-cf0f599c5ff1.def: ANY FORM OF PHYSICAL, MENTAL, SEXUAL, OR ECONOMIC EXPLOITATION OR CRUELTY WITHIN ANY RELATIONSHIP OF TRUST THAT CAUSES SIGNIFICANT HARM TO AN OLDER PERSON

9b33f8ae-950c-4a40-9010-5b9e2cd56b09.label: INQUESTS
9b33f8ae-950c-4a40-9010-5b9e2cd56b09.def: INQUIRIES INTO DEATHS THE CAUSES OF WHICH ARE UNKNOWN

61c87cce-3c48-4825-9bcc-953aa28944aa.label: AGEING
61c87cce-3c48-4825-9bcc-953aa28944aa.def: A TIME OF TRANSITION FROM MID-LIFE TO LATER LIFE

4530916f-3db4-46c0-9813-7a6bf92e23cb.label: GENETIC ENGINEERING
4530916f-3db4-46c0-9813-7a6bf92e23cb.def: MANIPULATION OF THE GENOME OF A LIVING ORGANISM

d8bcfa28-8f1d-4e70-a249-04e9a6713175.label: POSTNATAL CARE
d8bcfa28-8f1d-4e70-a249-04e9a6713175.def: CARE PROVIDED FOR THE MOTHER AND HER NEWBORN BABY/IES FOR SIX WEEKS AFTER DELIVERY.

84da07dd-0457-484c-8b9c-eda3e7efcc24.label: SINGLEHOOD (CIVIL STATUS)
84da07dd-0457-484c-8b9c-eda3e7efcc24.def: THE STATE OF BEING SINGLE (CIVIL STATUS)

de7cca74-098d-4ec6-82b0-7c85b94473ca.label: WILDLIFE
de7cca74-098d-4ec6-82b0-7c85b94473ca.def: THE NATIVE FAUNA AND FLORA OF A PARTICULAR REGION

4746b7b1-0daa-42cf-b477-6ba90f79b22e.label: SECONDARY EDUCATION
4746b7b1-0daa-42cf-b477-6ba90f79b22e.def: A BROAD TERM TO COVER ISCED LEVELS 2 AND 3

a9e2b4d0-9392-41ca-9a90-09b28c71834e.label: LOWER SECONDARY EDUCATION
a9e2b4d0-9392-41ca-9a90-09b28c71834e.def: ISCED LEVEL 2. THE CONTENTS OF EDUCATION AT THIS STAGE ARE TYPICALLY DESIGNED TO COMPLETE THE PROVISION OF BASIC EDUCATION WHICH BEGAN AT ISCED LEVEL 1 (PRIMARY EDUCATION). ENTRY AGE IS AFTER SOME 6 YEARS OF PRIMARY EDUCATION AND ENDS AFTER SOME 9 YEARS OF SCHOOLING SINCE THE BEGINNING OF PRIMARY EDUCATION. THE END OF THIS LEVEL OFTEN COINCIDES WITH THE END OF COMPULSORY EDUCATION.

c601456c-944a-47b2-ae5b-569c3a9adcf4.label: UPPER SECONDARY EDUCATION
c601456c-944a-47b2-ae5b-569c3a9adcf4.def: ISCED LEVEL 3. THIS LEVEL OF EDUCATION TYPICALLY BEGINS AT THE END OF FULL-TIME COMPULSORY EDUCATION WITH A TYPICAL ENTRANCE AGE OF 15 OR 16 YEARS. MINIMUM ENTRANCE REQUIREMENTS ARE THE COMPLETION OF LEVEL 2 EDUCATION OR DEMONSTRABLE ABILITY TO HANDLE PROGRAMMES AT THIS LEVEL.

9dc812fb-f287-4ef3-909d-ea797b279f90.label: SECONDARY SCHOOL LEAVING
9dc812fb-f287-4ef3-909d-ea797b279f90.def: REFERS TO SCHOOL LEAVING UPON COMPLETION OF COMPULSORY EDUCATION

482c6991-0017-4718-8414-03b98b25a425.label: INTERNAL MIGRATION
482c6991-0017-4718-8414-03b98b25a425.def: PEOPLE CHANGING THEIR PLACE OF RESIDENCE ACROSS INTERNAL ADMINISTRATIVE BOUNDARIES WITHOUT LEAVING THE COUNTRY

a67d8b25-e6f3-4939-810b-56e1e77eceb1.label: COURT ORDERS
a67d8b25-e6f3-4939-810b-56e1e77eceb1.def: DIRECTIONS ISSUED BY A COURT OR JUDGE, USUALLY REQUIRING A PERSON TO DO OR REFRAIN FROM DOING SOMETHING

bb38d4be-aaab-4bb3-9020-05aca2b05170.label: HIGHER AND FURTHER EDUCATION TEACHING PERSONNEL

4a214e4f-e0f4-43ce-b078-9e92ffd522a5.label: NUMBER OF BIRTHS OUTSIDE OF A MARRIAGE OR CIVIL PARTNERSHIP
alt: BIRTHS OUTSIDE OF A MARRIAGE OR CIVIL PARTNERSHIP
4a214e4f-e0f4-43ce-b078-9e92ffd522a5.def: NUMBER OF LIVE BIRTHS OUTSIDE OF A MARRIAGE OR CIVIL PARTNERSHIP IN A POPULATON IN A GIVEN PERIOD

4ae8f7d8-3ff9-4258-9dc8-7cf9c345dd6f.label: HEADS OF HOUSEHOLD
4ae8f7d8-3ff9-4258-9dc8-7cf9c345dd6f.def: A PERSON WHO OWNS, OR IS OTHERWISE IN CHARGE OF, A DWELLING

4cb8c998-46e1-4da9-ba49-c194e24f0223.label: MEDICAL HISTORY
4cb8c998-46e1-4da9-ba49-c194e24f0223.def: RECORD OF AN INDIVIDUAL'S ILLNESSES, MEDICAL TREATMENTS, ETC.

d4dcff2c-6d8c-4b60-b029-84cfacbc13a3.label: TENANCY AGREEMENTS
d4dcff2c-6d8c-4b60-b029-84cfacbc13a3.def: ARRANGEMENT IN WHICH OWNER ALLOWS ANOTHER PERSON (TENANT) TO TAKE POSSESSION OF THE LAND OR BUILDING FOR AN AGREED PERIOD, USUALLY IN RETURN FOR RENT. RANGES FROM FORMAL LEASE BY DEED TO INFORMAL VERBAL ARRANGEMENT

b1ab6f66-f3ed-42ec-9af5-2a896bdf119f.label: EDUCATIONAL GROUPING
b1ab6f66-f3ed-42ec-9af5-2a896bdf119f.def: A GENERAL TERM TO COVER THE DIFFERENT WAYS THAT STUDENTS CAN BE GROUPED, E.G. BY ABILITY, ALPHABETICALLY, GEOGRAPHICALLY, BY ACADEMIC SUBJECT

f6c3a44c-74dd-4c24-a089-b25f1f12db09.label: STREET CHILDREN
f6c3a44c-74dd-4c24-a089-b25f1f12db09.def: CHILDREN WHO DEPEND ON THE STREETS TO LIVE AND/OR WORK, WHETHER ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY

96c13579-78a9-4e42-a9bf-561cedca9945.label: DATA BREACHES
96c13579-78a9-4e42-a9bf-561cedca9945.def: ACCIDENTAL OR UNLAWFUL DESTRUCTION, LOSS, ALTERATION, UNAUTHORISED DISCLOSURE OF, OR ACCESS TO, PERSONAL DATA

4f4eb873-9356-4a25-b828-370f750ca86c.label: TUTORIALS
4f4eb873-9356-4a25-b828-370f750ca86c.def: A PERIOD OF TUITION GIVEN BY A UNIVERSITY ETC. TUTOR TO AN INDIVIDUAL PUPIL OR A SMALL GROUP

763dbbab-94cc-4582-b7c3-6c8b2ceab075.label: PANSEXUALITY
763dbbab-94cc-4582-b7c3-6c8b2ceab075.def: SEXUAL ATTRACTION TO PEOPLE REGARDLESS OF THEIR SEX OR GENDER IDENTITY

f125400e-39f5-4a23-922a-c7eb72a66f76.label: RELATIONSHIP BREAKDOWN
f125400e-39f5-4a23-922a-c7eb72a66f76.def: RELATIONSHIP BREAKDOWN SHORT OF DIVORCE OR DISSOLUTION OF CIVIL PARTNERSHIP

d37e4e93-e5b5-4896-981e-69ee85b0bb64.label: OCCUPATIONAL DISEASES
d37e4e93-e5b5-4896-981e-69ee85b0bb64.def: DISEASES DUE TO FACTORS INVOLVED IN ONE'S EMPLOYMENT

c061faca-8205-4512-a22f-19f4328d267b.label: DEVELOPMENT POLICY
c061faca-8205-4512-a22f-19f4328d267b.def: A DEFINITE COURSE OR METHOD OF ACTION SELECTED FROM AMONG DEVELOPMENT ALTERNATIVES AND IN THE LIGHT OF GIVEN CONDITIONS. THIS TERM REFERS TO DEVELOPMENT POLICY AT EITHER NATIONAL OR INTERNATIONAL LEVEL.

d3cfa989-3818-44ec-b0e4-d3e11f48979a.label: PENSION BENEFITS
d3cfa989-3818-44ec-b0e4-d3e11f48979a.def: THE VALUE OF A PENSION, OR THE AMOUNT RECEIVED WHEN A PENSION IS DRAWN

5375557e-af53-4f47-acb8-aba9284908e0.label: ADULT EDUCATION TEACHERS
asc: HIGHER AND FURTHER EDUCATION TEACHING PERSONNEL

54ea820a-5b91-4650-8844-1f77ae4e083a.label: TELEWORKERS
54ea820a-5b91-4650-8844-1f77ae4e083a.def: THOSE WORKING AT A DISTANCE (INCLUDING WORK AT HOME) EMPLOYING TELECOMMUNICATION AND/OR COMPUTER FACILITIES

fe7f4142-8698-4cc1-bea3-b943d7a01673.label: DIGITAL NOMADS
fe7f4142-8698-4cc1-bea3-b943d7a01673.def: PEOPLE WHO CHOOSE A TRAVELLING LIFESTYLE WHILE CARRYING OUT THEIR WORK REMOTELY WITH MODERN TECHNOLOGY

57786866-e214-4813-bc50-d82cfb076f19.label: DROPPING OUT (EDUCATION)
57786866-e214-4813-bc50-d82cfb076f19.def: PREMATURE SCHOOL LEAVING BEFORE COMPLETING A CYCLE OR COURSE ALREADY BEGUN

5532c4e2-9ba8-430f-9687-4f6c838bee5f.label: COHABITING
5532c4e2-9ba8-430f-9687-4f6c838bee5f.def: PERSONS WHO LIVE TOGETHER IN A ROMANTIC RELATIONSHIP, WITHOUT BEING IN A LEGAL UNION

910f6545-3e93-4f09-a214-e203d7d3fcc6.label: COHABITATION
910f6545-3e93-4f09-a214-e203d7d3fcc6.def: THE STATE OF LIVING TOGETHER IN A ROMANTIC RELATIONSHIP, WITHOUT BEING IN A LEGAL UNION

c52057cc-c46b-484e-abd5-8b7e49ed70c5.label: SOCIAL ECONOMY
c52057cc-c46b-484e-abd5-8b7e49ed70c5.def: THAT PART OF THE ECONOMY WHICH IS NEITHER PRIVATE NOR PUBLIC, BUT CONSISTS OF CONSTITUTED ORGANISATIONS WHICH ARE RUN ON A NOT-FOR-PROFIT BASIS (E.G. COMMUNITY BUSINESSES, CO-OPERATIVES, LOCAL SELF-HELP OR INTEREST GROUPS) UNDERTAKING ACTIVITIES FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE COMMUNITY

569a46d8-b049-47f9-9f1a-9fd78293cd4c.label: TERTIARY EDUCATION
569a46d8-b049-47f9-9f1a-9fd78293cd4c.def: THIS ENCOMPASSES ISCED LEVELS 5 AND 6. TERTIARY EDUCATION IS FORMAL, NON-COMPULSORY EDUCATION THAT FOLLOWS SECONDARY EDUCATION.

62fe7681-abe4-4a5a-991e-763a8e9503a7.label: TERTIARY EDUCATION (FIRST STAGE)
62fe7681-abe4-4a5a-991e-763a8e9503a7.def: ISCED LEVEL 5. THIS FIRST STAGE OF TERTIARY EDUCATION LEADS TO A DEGREE OR A QUALIFICATION WHICH GIVES ACCESS TO PROFESSIONS WITH HIGH SKILLS REQUIREMENTS. IT DOES NOT LEAD DIRECTLY TO AN ADVANCED RESEARCH QUALIFICATION.

690d5b2b-483d-4631-8b65-e1192f592466.label: TERTIARY EDUCATION (SECOND STAGE)
690d5b2b-483d-4631-8b65-e1192f592466.def: ISCED LEVEL 6. THIS SECOND STAGE LEADS TO AN AWARD OF AN ADVANCED RESEARCH QUALIFICATION. IT TYPICALLY REQUIRES THE SUBMISSION OF A THESIS OR DISSERTATION OF PUBLISHABLE QUALITY WHICH IS THE PRODUCT OF ORIGINAL RESEARCH AND REPRESENTS A SIGNIFICANT CONTRIBUTION TO KNOWLEDGE

805eeb5c-8acd-4a19-876f-6cce37815258.label: STUDENTS (COLLEGE)
805eeb5c-8acd-4a19-876f-6cce37815258.def: STUDENTS INVOLVED IN TERTIARY EDUCATION (FURTHER OR HIGHER EDUCATION)

585e2cbc-d819-441b-9468-c28c94505645.label: TOXICOLOGY
585e2cbc-d819-441b-9468-c28c94505645.def: THE SCIENCE OF POISONS; THAT DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY OR MEDICINE WHICH DEALS WITH THE NATURE AND EFFECT OF POISONS

63972609-2e8d-4b1b-befc-df5738f91176.label: UNDERGRADUATES
63972609-2e8d-4b1b-befc-df5738f91176.def: A STUDENT IN A UNIVERSITY WHO HAS NOT YET TAKEN A DEGREE

a6b306d1-0dbc-4ffb-8932-64d20a1e76de.label: POST-GRADUATES
a6b306d1-0dbc-4ffb-8932-64d20a1e76de.def: STUDENTS WHO TAKE A POST-GRADUATE COURSE, OR CONTINUE WITH THEIR STUDIES AFTER GRADUATION

cc14523d-4a5d-4f86-a81f-ab98c69e8ca2.label: BOOK READERSHIP
cc14523d-4a5d-4f86-a81f-ab98c69e8ca2.def: THE TOTAL NUMBER OF READERS OF A BOOK; ALL, OR A SECTION, OF SUCH READERS CONSIDERED COLLECTIVELY

5de1db2a-b60d-4357-8d0d-2405577e6a78.label: BIBLIOGRAPHIC DATA
5de1db2a-b60d-4357-8d0d-2405577e6a78.def: DATA NECESSARY FOR THE IDENTIFICATION OF AN AUTHOR, TITLE, SOURCE, DATE OF PUBLICATION, ETC.

dc9b762a-8804-418e-b5c6-6a54061a2b4a.label: BASIC EDUCATION PROGRAMMES
dc9b762a-8804-418e-b5c6-6a54061a2b4a.def: BASIC GENERAL PROGRAMMES MORE USUALLY AT PRE-PRIMARY, ELEMENTARY, PRIMARY, SECONDARY EDUCATION LEVELS, I.E. ISCED FIRST AND SECOND STAGES OF EDUCATION. THIS TERM COVERS INSTRUCTION IN ELEMENTARY SUBJECTS AND TRAINING IN SOCIAL SKILLS AND RESPONSIBILITIES.

8c26c5d6-93ed-4f9d-8ec9-0198a6133af1.label: CONSERVATION AREAS
8c26c5d6-93ed-4f9d-8ec9-0198a6133af1.def: AN AREA DEEMED TO BE OF SPECIAL ARCHITECTURAL, NATURAL, OR OTHER INTEREST, WHOSE CHARACTER AND APPEARANCE ARE PROTECTED (USUALLY BY LAW) FROM UNDESIRABLE CHANGES

e8fab301-605f-4e17-abb0-9fa86538a228.label: HABITATS
e8fab301-605f-4e17-abb0-9fa86538a228.def: THE PLACE WHERE AN ANIMAL OR PLANT NORMALLY LIVES

c2063c20-6718-4b32-9bce-81830bf1f384.label: VOCATIONAL EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS
c2063c20-6718-4b32-9bce-81830bf1f384.def: THIS TERM IS USED FOR ISCED LEVEL 3 AND ISCED LEVEL 4 INSTITUTIONS.

d179f170-3354-4719-a625-d6976e7de2b0.label: HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS
d179f170-3354-4719-a625-d6976e7de2b0.def: BASIC TERM FOR INSTITUTIONS OF TERTIARY EDUCATION

f922499c-61aa-4783-9baf-71a058472ffd.label: TRAINING CENTRES
f922499c-61aa-4783-9baf-71a058472ffd.def: THIS TERM COVERS TRAINING CENTRES RUN BY PRIVATE ORGANIZATIONS, CENTRAL OR LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND EMPLOYERS.

c3f97cc8-ece7-4c2d-85be-1eef3bcf88c5.label: SINGLE FATHERS
c3f97cc8-ece7-4c2d-85be-1eef3bcf88c5.def: FATHERS WHO ARE THE ONLY CARETAKER OF A DEPENDENT CHILD OR CHILDREN

fe1a5332-3091-4f25-be4d-cb03fb2e48c9.label: VOCABULARY SKILLS
fe1a5332-3091-4f25-be4d-cb03fb2e48c9.def: THE EXTENT OF AN INDIVIDUAL'S KNOWLEDGE OR USE OF WORDS

6784da6b-ed16-4908-8aeb-ab04c07cfede.label: MOTOR PROCESSES
6784da6b-ed16-4908-8aeb-ab04c07cfede.def: ABILITY TO MANIPULATE AND CONTROL LIMB AND BODY MOVEMENTS

f8d85575-4574-49c0-9ecc-a244d3396701.label: AUTOMATION
f8d85575-4574-49c0-9ecc-a244d3396701.def: PRODUCTION BY MACHINERY, USUALLY COMPUTER-CONTROLLED, WITHOUT THE NEED FOR IMMEDIATE HUMAN INTERVENTION

f0c23a85-46b7-4fbe-afdf-345818362649.label: FERTILITY (HUMAN)
f0c23a85-46b7-4fbe-afdf-345818362649.def: ABILITY TO CONCEIVE A CHILD, IN BOTH MEN AND WOMEN

69d605d4-1a74-4921-90ee-7de858f635a1.label: BIODIVERSITY
69d605d4-1a74-4921-90ee-7de858f635a1.def: BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY, ESPECIALLY AT ECOSYSTEM, SPECIES AND GENETIC LEVEL

6a97ce5a-edbc-4513-8063-98edf22dd307.label: READING READINESS
6a97ce5a-edbc-4513-8063-98edf22dd307.def: DEVELOPMENTAL LEVEL AT WHICH AN INDIVIDUAL IS ABLE TO PROFIT FROM SPECIFIC READING ACTIVITIES

ddaffc6e-5751-40a2-bfc0-5b00b2341bf1.label: DEVELOPMENT AID (INTERNATIONAL)
ddaffc6e-5751-40a2-bfc0-5b00b2341bf1.def: DEVELOPMENT AID GIVEN BY ONE COUNTRY TO ANOTHER

730df5ec-cb2e-4086-8f5d-f2c429fc4353.label: RELIGIOUS INSTRUCTION
730df5ec-cb2e-4086-8f5d-f2c429fc4353.def: INSTRUCTION IN THE BELIEFS AND PRACTICES OF RELIGION AT ANY LEVEL NOT LEADING TO A POST-SECONDARY QUALIFICATION

6d596419-a457-4fa7-a533-d9c91249594d.label: POLITICAL MINORITIES
6d596419-a457-4fa7-a533-d9c91249594d.def: POLITICAL GROUPS REPRESENTING ONLY A SMALL PERCENTAGE OF THE POPULATION

b9bfa467-0d48-458c-aa6e-11e3c3241ef4.label: PRESCRIPTION DRUGS
b9bfa467-0d48-458c-aa6e-11e3c3241ef4.def: MEDICINES AND MEDICATIONS PRESCRIBED BY MEDICAL PERSONNEL

6d9665d1-cfa6-4750-8f27-f3daaf4f4c66.label: AGE DISTRIBUTION
6d9665d1-cfa6-4750-8f27-f3daaf4f4c66.def: DIVISION OF A POPULATION ACCORDING TO AGE OR AGE GROUP

a373ad2a-82e6-4d86-adf8-7e3261826e15.label: VOCATIONAL EDUCATION
a373ad2a-82e6-4d86-adf8-7e3261826e15.def: FORMAL EDUCATION TAKING PLACE IN SCHOOL OR OTHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS, DESIGNED TO TEACH SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED FOR SPECIFIC TRADES OR OCCUPATIONS

6e692b29-de6d-4fc7-b3ed-5d13c6ce28df.label: STUDENT PARTICIPATION
6e692b29-de6d-4fc7-b3ed-5d13c6ce28df.def: INVOLVEMENT OF STUDENTS IN EDUCATIONAL OR NON-EDUCATIONAL ACTIVITIES

799e24b4-b38b-4052-96dd-099227d65621.label: HOME SHARING
799e24b4-b38b-4052-96dd-099227d65621.def: A LIVING ARRANGEMENT IN WHICH A NUMBER OF PEOPLE SHARE A SINGLE ACCOMMODATION, TYPICALLY AS HOUSEMATES OR FLATMATES

bd908f56-3375-4cae-b773-c6040963a85f.label: INFANT FEEDING
bd908f56-3375-4cae-b773-c6040963a85f.def: THE PROVISION OF BREAST MILK, OR A BOTTLE SUBSTITUTE, FOR A NUMBER OF MONTHS AFTER BIRTH AND THEREAFTER NUTRITIONALLY ADEQUATE AND SAFE COMPLEMENTARY FOODS UNTIL THE INFANT OR YOUNG CHILD IS FULLY WEANED

f2e6a141-f432-4fa3-b385-ca4083f4bc96.label: LEGAL AGE
f2e6a141-f432-4fa3-b385-ca4083f4bc96.def: THE AGE AT WHICH A PERSON CAN LEGALLY CARRY OUT CERTAIN ACTIONS, E.G. LEAVING HOME, BUYING ALCOHOL OR CIGARETTES, DRIVING A CAR, GETTING MARRIED

7951ea43-0f97-449e-8dda-3496e1347ddd.label: CITIZENSHIP
7951ea43-0f97-449e-8dda-3496e1347ddd.def: THE EXTENT AND QUALITY OF ACTUAL CIVIC PARTICIPATION

7b39e5f4-5a43-4e1b-a630-0bdd1e249234.label: PRIVATE SCHOOLS
7b39e5f4-5a43-4e1b-a630-0bdd1e249234.def: SCHOOLS NOT ADMINISTERED BY LOCAL, STATE OR NATIONAL GOVERNMENT, WHICH RETAIN THE RIGHT TO SELECT THEIR STUDENTS AND ARE FUNDED WHOLLY OR PARTLY BY CHARGING THEIR STUDENTS TUITION FEES RATHER THAN BY PUBLIC/STATE FUNDING. THEY MOSTLY COMPLY WITH REGULATIONS RELATING TO THE EDUCATIONAL CONTENT TAUGHT.

867d683a-9040-4327-b1f4-47f31bd1c797.def: SIMPLE AND FUNCTIONAL LITERACY AND NUMERACY EDUCATION

875c6a39-2366-473a-a6f0-5be5cbc2b63d.label: CONSCIENTIOUS OBJECTION
875c6a39-2366-473a-a6f0-5be5cbc2b63d.def: REFUSAL TO PERFORM MILITARY SERVICE DUE TO ONE'S BELIEFS, MORAL CONCERNS OR RELIGION

87a086c3-b94c-478d-90db-00162adbd922.label: MASCULINITY
87a086c3-b94c-478d-90db-00162adbd922.def: A SET OF ATTRIBUTES, BEHAVIOURS AND ROLES GENERALLY ASSOCIATED WITH BOYS AND MEN

88e810a4-ffbb-4231-83ec-bdabdef01d2c.label: ADOLESCENCE
88e810a4-ffbb-4231-83ec-bdabdef01d2c.def: THE TRANSITIONAL STAGE OF DEVELOPMENT BETWEEN CHILDHOOD AND FULL ADULTHOOD. THERE IS NO FIXED AGE, BUT THE WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION DEFINES IT AS ENCOMPASSING AGES 10-20.

b58f36f4-7d84-46eb-aeac-6175630f8170.label: ADOLESCENTS
b58f36f4-7d84-46eb-aeac-6175630f8170.def: THOSE IN THE TRANSITIONAL STAGE OF DEVELOPMENT BETWEEN CHILDHOOD AND FULL ADULTHOOD. ACCORDING TO THE WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION, THIS MAY INCLUDE THOSE BETWEEN THE AGES OF 10 AND 20.

8b731d5b-f378-46a1-9bbe-fc23046a724b.label: CHILD DAY CARE
8b731d5b-f378-46a1-9bbe-fc23046a724b.def: NON-RESIDENTIAL CARE OF CHILDREN BY PERSONS OTHER THAN THEIR PARENTS OR GUARDIANS

b8ae6bd1-45a1-43d4-a0b2-d753ed94d143.label: FAITH SCHOOLS
b8ae6bd1-45a1-43d4-a0b2-d753ed94d143.def: SCHOOLS, BOTH PRIMARY AND SECONDARY, WHICH ARE PROVIDED UNDER THE AEGIS OF A RECOGNIZED RELIGIOUS FAITH. THE RANGE OF SUCH A PROVISION REFLECTS A MULTI-DENOMINATIONAL, MULTICULTURAL SOCIETY.

8d629405-4a63-46ff-abda-6e4afaef1681.label: EDUCATIONAL MIGRATION
8d629405-4a63-46ff-abda-6e4afaef1681.def: THE MOVEMENT OF INDIVIDUALS, TYPICALLY STUDENTS, ACROSS REGIONAL OR NATIONAL BORDERS TO PURSUE EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES

8d9a1c46-0090-4b67-b8de-ff71fcf15f30.label: SPORTING SANCTIONS
8d9a1c46-0090-4b67-b8de-ff71fcf15f30.def: THE PREVENTION OF A COUNTRY'S PEOPLE AND TEAMS FROM COMPETING IN INTERNATIONAL EVENTS

a95e29e2-37bb-4386-bae0-2fb4079f2ca3.label: CHILD SAFETY
a95e29e2-37bb-4386-bae0-2fb4079f2ca3.def: FREEDOM FROM, OR PREVENTION OF, HARM OR DANGER TO CHILDREN

c5e5208d-cba7-4f60-8b6b-b775c7026988.label: FOREIGN STUDENTS
c5e5208d-cba7-4f60-8b6b-b775c7026988.def: STUDENTS WHO ARE NOT NATIVE TO THE COUNTRY IN WHICH THEY ARE STUDYING

c21f1fc2-e56f-4cca-bdeb-a1b7cae35afd.label: CHIEF INCOME EARNERS
c21f1fc2-e56f-4cca-bdeb-a1b7cae35afd.def: PERSON IN THE HOUSEHOLD WITH THE LARGEST INCOME, WHETHER FROM THEIR EMPLOYMENT, PENSION, STATE BENEFITS, INVESTMENTS OR ANY OTHER SOURCE

cf5b81c0-c4ee-4ddf-a175-8ffb3ff6c24e.label: HEALTH STATUS
cf5b81c0-c4ee-4ddf-a175-8ffb3ff6c24e.def: A DESCRIPTION AND/OR MEASUREMENT OF THE HEALTH OF AN INDIVIDUAL OR POPULATION

c0a3528a-da4a-4f2c-8846-1fc3427f52f9.label: INDIGENOUS PEOPLES
c0a3528a-da4a-4f2c-8846-1fc3427f52f9.def: THOSE WHO INHABITED A COUNTRY OR A GEOGRAPHICAL REGION AT THE TIME WHEN PEOPLE OF DIFFERENT CULTURES OR ETHNIC ORIGINS ARRIVED

f7ecd8b2-447a-46f1-903a-73bb2c386061.label: ROBBERY
f7ecd8b2-447a-46f1-903a-73bb2c386061.def: THEFT INVOLVING USE OR THREAT OF VIOLENCE

d0a1609e-be94-4489-a9cc-11e64aaaad91.label: DEPORTATION
d0a1609e-be94-4489-a9cc-11e64aaaad91.def: THE ACTION OF A STATE IN FORCING SOMEONE TO LEAVE A COUNTRY

ffbccd58-8f85-4c36-9037-692d6e34ce41.def: THE COST OF MAINTAINING A GIVEN STANDARD OF LIVING

bee3f71f-4142-4c4d-82dc-fb999fd8fb6d.def: ACCESS TO THE INTERNET, WHICH MAY BE VIA COMPUTER, MOBILE PHONE, DIGITAL TELEVISION, OR OTHER MEDIUM

a4203cfa-0484-4c77-9a9e-84b4376865f2.label: OBLIGATIONS
a4203cfa-0484-4c77-9a9e-84b4376865f2.def: AN ACT OR COURSE OF ACTION TO WHICH A PERSON IS MORALLY OR LEGALLY BOUND

db1228a5-b3f4-44b2-bdd8-f05437c30475.label: POLICY MONITORING
db1228a5-b3f4-44b2-bdd8-f05437c30475.def: A PROCESS WHEREBY AN IMPLEMENTED POLICY IS CONTINUALLY ASSESSED TO ENSURE THAT IT IS FULFILLING ITS PURPOSE

a7561d6f-f6f7-4840-ba86-0585987d8abc.label: ON-SITE WORK

bba0dc5f-8035-4a8c-b802-0fbf79d08bde.def: PERSONS WHO CARRY OUT THEIR WORK IN THE PREMISES OF THEIR EMPLOYER OR CLIENT

c315b380-1688-476f-b95d-fbbe76cecee3.def: WHERE A WORKER HOLDS MORE THAN ONE JOB AT THE SAME TIME, LEGALLY, EITHER FOR TWO OR MORE DIFFERENT EMPLOYERS OR AS SELF-EMPLOYED FOR ONE OF THE JOBS

d78df13c-100e-4290-9ed5-e3cca4211ed9.def: THE PRACTICE OF ALTERNATING BETWEEN WORKING IN THE WORKPLACE AND IN OTHER AGREED LOCATIONS INCLUDING HOME

fbc52e4c-9292-44ce-81b0-2e8867932c4f.def: SPEECH OR WRITING HAVING MANY UNFAMILIAR TERMS OR RESTRICTED TO A PARTICULAR CATEGORY OF PEOPLE OR OCCUPATION

af58005d-a990-458f-8bdd-c6eb82f8769e.def: PERSONS WHOSE LEGAL CIVIL PARTNERS HAVE DIED

eeca9b3a-bded-48f3-81e0-994b5b70dc21.def: THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF PEOPLE LIVING WITHIN A PARTICULAR LAND AREA SUCH AS A SQUARE MILE OR KILOMETER

c8e17698-1958-4298-ba47-d0c3189066f4.def: PERSONS WHO ALTERNATE BETWEEN WORKING IN THE WORKPLACE AND IN OTHER AGREED LOCATIONS INCLUDING HOME

803a0fc5-5965-4c4f-8ef0-bac0472a2402.def: A FAMILY GROUP THAT CONSISTS ONLY OF BOTH PARENTS AND CHILDREN

6ecb71d9-ae4c-4249-b604-a670304a9bdf.def: FAMILIES CONSISTING OF TWO ADULTS AND CHILDREN INCLUDING ONE OR MORE THAT THEY HAVE WITH PREVIOUS PARTNERS

ea0a225f-68e6-4d2d-9162-e614aa2fde64.label: GLOBAL HEALTH
ea0a225f-68e6-4d2d-9162-e614aa2fde64.def: HEALTH ISSUES THAT TRANSCEND NATIONAL BOUNDARIES AND AFFECT PEOPLE WORLDWIDE

1407e803-07b5-45b0-8c88-6fbecfbe1ca9.def: AN ARRANGEMENT, TYPICALLY FOLLOWING SEPARATION OR DIVORCE, BUT ALSO WHERE THE PARENTS ARE NOT, OR NEVER HAVE BEEN, IN A ROMANTIC RELATIONSHIP, WHERE PARENTS SHARE IN THE UPBRINGING OF A CHILD. THE ARRANGEMENT MAY BE FORMAL OR INFORMAL.

01cee295-ee2d-41f3-a874-a6f1626f22a4.label: APPRENTICESHIPS
01cee295-ee2d-41f3-a874-a6f1626f22a4.def: ANY SYSTEM BY WHICH AN EMPLOYER UNDERTAKES BY CONTRACT TO EMPLOY A PERSON AND TO TRAIN THEM OR HAVE THEM TRAINED SYSTEMATICALLY FOR A TRADE OR PROFESSION FOR A PERIOD THE DURATION OF WHICH HAS BEEN FIXED IN ADVANCE AND IN THE COURSE OF WHICH THE APPRENTICE IS BOUND TO WORK IN THE EMPLOYER'S SERVICE

2c79c330-e999-4dc9-ac03-ae8f84d8b935.label: DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY
2c79c330-e999-4dc9-ac03-ae8f84d8b935.def: ANY TECHNOLOGY THAT IS BASED ON REPRESENTING DATA AS SEQUENCES OF NUMBERS, I.E. AS DIGITAL DATA

2aaa159f-08ed-4160-b5dd-b2a1993a0655.label: SINGLES (LIFESTYLE)
2aaa159f-08ed-4160-b5dd-b2a1993a0655.def: PERSONS WHO DEFINE THEMSELVES AS SINGLE, REGARDLESS OF THEIR CIVIL STATUS

44c1bd74-291f-4f5c-b2b3-8065ec3c66f8.label: CHILD MORTALITY
44c1bd74-291f-4f5c-b2b3-8065ec3c66f8.def: NUMBER OF DEATHS OF CHILDREN BETWEEN ONE AND FIVE YEARS OF AGE IN A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD

529b94f9-16f7-41d6-b437-731147bc3993.def: MORBIDITY RATE REFERS TO THE SPREAD OF A PARTICULAR ILLNESS, DISEASE, OR HEALTH CONDITION IN A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF CASES OF A PARTICULAR ILLNESS, DISEASE, OR HEALTH CONDITION PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR.

5a2dfc3e-5f3a-445a-92b6-09e77be06f92.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF COHABITING PERSONS (I.E.THOSE LIVING TOGETHER IN A ROMANTIC RELATIONSHIP, WITHOUT BEING IN A LEGAL UNION) TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF COHABITING PERSONS PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

247ac537-c094-4194-b242-0919b96ba09d.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF CIVIL PARTNERSHIPS TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF CIVIL PARTNERSHIPS PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

7c55f31a-78cc-428c-9963-b519ad4938e2.def: THE RATIO OF THE NUMBER OF CIVIL PARTNERSHIP DISSOLUTIONS TO THE SIZE OF A POPULATION IN A GIVEN PERIOD, USUALLY EXPRESSED AS THE NUMBER OF CIVIL PARTNERSHIP DISSOLUTIONS PER 1,000 OF POPULATION PER YEAR

c017d090-991e-4984-b942-1dbbafb73bd4.def: MOVEMENT OF PERSONS THAT TAKES PLACE OUTSIDE THE LAWS, REGULATIONS, OR INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENTS GOVERNING THE ENTRY INTO OR EXIT FROM THE STATE OF ORIGIN, TRANSIT OR DESTINATION

ctx_en.en:1:
**Demography** **(101-1)**  is the scientific study of human populations primarily with respect to their size, their **structure** **(101-2)** and their development; it takes into account the quantitative aspects of their general characteristics. It is the core of the **population sciences** **(101-8)**, which in the broadest sense include interdisciplinary fields such as *economic demography* (104-1), *social demography* (104-2), *population genetics* (104-4), *historical demography* (102-1), *mathematical demography* (102-6) as well as contributions from the law, medicine, epidemiology (423-6), sociology, psychology, geography and philosophy. In statistical terminology any collection of distinct elements may be called a **population** **(101-3)**, a word that is synonymous with **universe** **(101-3)**. However, in demographic usage, the term **population** **(101-4)** refers to all of the **inhabitants** **(101-5)** of a given area, though on occasion it may be used for part of the inhabitants only [e.g., the *school-age population* (cf. 346-7), the *marriageable population* (cf. 514-2)]. Such groups are properly called **sub-populations** **(101-6)**. The term population is often used to denote more specifically the **size** **(101-7)**, i.e., the **total number** **(101-7)** of the aggregate referred to in no. 101-4.
 - **101-1**  **Demography**, n. - **demographic**, adj. - **demographer**, n.: a specialist in demography.
 - **101-4**  **Population**, n. - Note that this term may also be used adjectivally as a synonym for demographic, e.g., in population problems, population analysis, population studies.
 - **101-5**  **Inhabitant**, n. - **inhabit**, v.: to occupy as a place of settled residence.
ctx_en.en:2: Certain sub-disciplines within demography have received special names reflecting their objectives or their methodology. **Historical demography** **(102-1)** deals with populations of the past for which written records are available. In the absence of such sources, the study of ancient populations takes the name of **paleo-demography** **(102-2)** . In **descriptive demography** **(102-3)** the numbers, geographical distribution, structure and change of human populations are described by means of **population statistics** **(102-4)** or **demographic statistics** **(102-4)** . The treatment of quantitative relations among demographic phenomena in abstraction from their association with other phenomena, is called **theoretical demography** **(102-5)** or **pure demography** **(102-5)** ; because of its resort to various mathematical methods, in practice it is identified with **mathematical demography** **(102-6)**. A piece of research that applies the tools of *demographic analysis* (103-1) to an actual population is often called a **demographic study** **(102-7)**. This study can focus on the **current demographic situation** **(102-8)** or **current demographic conditions** **(102-8)**, i.e. the population change and its indicators during a short and recent period. All the preceding disciplines place a great emphasis on the numerical aspects of the phenomena, and are sometimes referred to as **formal demography** **(102-9)**, when they apply only to the size and structure of the population. In contrast the broader term **population studies** **(102-10)** also includes the treatment of relations between demographic events and social, economic or other phenomena.
ctx_en.en:3:
**Demographic analysis** **(103-1)** is that branch of formal demography which controls for the effect of population size and structure on **demographic processes** **(103-2)** and isolates the effects of demographic processes of interest from the others, the latter of which are called **competing processes** **(103-3)**. It also studies the relations between demographic variables and how they interact to form population structures. A distinction is made between **cohort analysis** **(103-4)** or **generational analysis** **(103-4)** which focuses on a well defined *cohort* (cf. 117-2) followed through time, and **cross-sectional analysis** **(103-5)** or **period analysis** **(103-5)** which focuses on the demographic phenomena that occur during a precise time interval (such as a calendar year) among several cohorts.
 - **103-4**  **Panel analysis** follows the same individuals case by case.
ctx_en.en:4:
The study of relations between demographic phenomena on one hand and economic and social phenomena on the other forms another branch of the subject. The terms **economic demography** **(104-1)** and **social demography** **(104-2)** have been used by some writers. Demography also deals with the study of **population quality** **(104-3)**. This phrase may be used with reference to all sorts of social and personal characteristics. In a slightly different sense the term primarily refers to the distribution and transmission of *hereditary characteristics* (910-3) which are the subject of **population genetics** **(104-4)** . **Human ecology** **(104-5)** is the study of the distribution and organization of communities with attention to the operation of competitive and cooperative processes and has part of its subject matter in common with demography. Fields of research and methodology are even more intertwined in the case of demography and **human geography** **(104-7)**. It is also the case for **biometry** **(104-6)** or **biometrics** **(104-6)** and **epidemiology** **(104-8)** which deal with the application of statistical methods to all forms of biological and medical research.
 - **104-4**  Population genetics is distinct from **human genetics**, which deals with the transmission of inheritable characteristics in man: population genetics includes the study of the distribution and transmission of hereditary traits in plant, animal and human populations.
 - **104-5**  **Ecology**, n. - **ecological**, adj. - **ecologist**, n.: a specialist in ecology.
 - **104-6**  **Biometry**, n. - **biometrics**, n. - **biometric**, adj. - **biometrician**, n.: a specialist in biometry. The terms **biostatistics**, n. - **biostatistical**, adj. - and **biostatistician**, n. are frequently encountered and are synonymous with the terms given for biometry.
ctx_en.en:5: Finally, there is the study of **population theories** **(105-1)**. This term should not be confused with *theoretical demography* (102-5). Population theories are designed to explain or predict the interaction between changes in population and economic, social, psychological or other factors; they include purely conceptual treatments. Population theories occasionally form the basis of **population policy** **(105-2)** (cf. §930), which deals with measures designed to influence population changes.
ctx_en.en:6:
A fundamental **statistical unit** **(110-1)** used in demography is the **individual** **(110-2)** or **person** **(110-2)** . The term **head** **(110-2)** has also been employed but this usage is now largely out of date. The **household** **(110-3)**, a socio-economic unit, consists of individuals who live together. Statistical definitions of the household vary. According to the definition which has been recommended as an international standard a household consists of a group of individuals who share *living quarters* (120-1) and their principal meals. The term **hearth** **(110-3)** has been used in the past, showing that in the past members of the household used to share the same fire. Classifications of households also vary between different countries and different enquiries. Most classifications involve the distinction of two types: **private households** **(110-4)** and **collective households** **(110-5)** . An individual living by himself is considered to be a **one-person household** **(110-6)** . A **boarder** **(110-7)** is a person other than a domestic servant, who is unrelated to other members of the household and who habitually takes his meals with the household. A **lodger** **(110-8)** or **roomer** **(110-8)**, on the other hand, does not habitually take his meals with the household. These two categories may or may not be included in the household for statistical purposes.
 - **110-4**  Private households are called **family households** when their members are related.
 - **110-5**  Collective  households may include **institutional households** composed of persons who reside in specifically designated institutions (e.g. hospitals, prisons, etc.). They may also include unrelated persons who reside in *group quarters* (120-1*) other than institutions. However, recent internationally recommended definitions restrict the terms household and **household population** to private households, and refer otherwise to **persons not living in households**.
ctx_en.en:7:
When a *private household* (110-4) contains several persons they are called **members of the household** **(111-1)** and one of them will be the **head of the household** **(111-2)**. There is no universally accepted rule as to who is considered the head of the household; in some cases it may be the **principal earner** **(111-3)**. On most census schedules there appears a question dealing with the **relationship** **(111-4)** (114-3*) of members of the household to its head. This enables a distinction to be made between different groups in **composite households** **(111-5)** or **complex households** **(111-5)** which contain members of more than one *biological family* or *nuclear family* (113-1). A composite or complex household can be disaggregated into several **nuclei** **(111-6)**, including a **primary nucleus** **(111-7)** and **secondary nuclei** **(111-8)**. The nuclei are more commonly called *families* (112-1). The **primary family** **(111-9)** is that of the household head when it is defined, the others are called **secondary families** **(111-10)**. **Household size** **(111-11)** denotes the number of persons included in the household.
 - **111-2**  The term **householder** is sometimes used to refer to the head of the household. The term **headship** is frequently encountered.
 - **111-6**  The nucleus is also called a **conjugal family unit**.
ctx_en.en:8:
The **family** **(112-1)** (cf. § 113 and § 115) is a different unit which must be carefully distinguished from the *household* (110-3). It is defined primarily by reference to relationships which pertain to or arise from marriage, reproduction or adoption, all of which are regulated by law or custom. The fundamental relationships are those established between a couple by marriage — and that existing between a couple as **parents** **(112-2)**, i.e., **father** **(112-3)** and **mother** **(112-4)**, and their **children** **(112-5)**, i.e., **sons** **(112-6)** and **daughters** **(112-7)** .
 - **112-2**  **Parent**, n. - **parental**, adj. - **parenthood**, n.: the state of being or becoming a parent.
 - **112-3**  **Father**, n. - **paternal**, adj.
 - **112-4**  **Mother**, n. - **maternal**, adj.
 - **112-6**  **Son**, n. - **filial**, adj.
 - **112-7**  **Daughter**, n. - **filial**, adj.
ctx_en.en:9:
Parents and their children are sometimes referred to as the **biological family** **(113-1)**, or **nuclear family** **(113-1)** . **Brothers** **(113-2)** and **sisters** **(113-3)**, without distinction of sex are called **sibs** **(113-4)** or **siblings** **(113-4)** . Siblings with only one parent in common are called **half-brothers** **(113-5)** or **half-sisters** **(113-6)**. **Extended families** **(113-7)** are larger family units generally composed of combinations of nuclear families. The **vertically extended family** **(113-8)** consists of three or more generations living in the same household or very close to each other. The **horizontally extended family** **(113-9)** involves siblings with their spouses and their children living together. The vertically extended family can generate special types such as the **stem family** **(113-10)** in which only one of the children (the heir) continues to reside with the parents after marriage, together with the heir's spouse and their own children.
 - **113-1**  The term **simple family** and **elementary family** are frequent synonyms for the terms biological or nuclear family. In a restricted sense, such as in fertility analyses, the term biological family may refer to parents and their own children, excluding adopted children.
 - **113-7**  The terms **composite family** and **joint family** are frequent synonyms for the term extended family. In the most general sense of the term, an extended family may refer to all members of a kinship group.
ctx_en.en:10:
Persons related through common **descent** **(114-1)** from the same **progenitor** **(114-2)** or **ancestor** **(114-2)** are called **blood relatives** **(114-3)** or **genetic relatives** **(114-3)** . The terms **kin** **(114-3)** and in an aggregate sense **kinship group** **(114-3)** are also used. The **degree of relationship** **(114-4)** is generally computed by reference to the number of steps which are necessary before a common ancestor is reached, but there are many different methods of computation. The fundamental relation in each of these steps is the **filial relation** **(114-5)** (cf. 112-6* and 112-7*) of child to parent, which is the reciprocal of **parenthood** **(114-6)** (112-2*) i.e. the relation of a couple or of a father or a mother to **offspring** **(114-7)** or **progeny** **(114-7)** . Blood relationship must be distinguished from **relationship by marriage** **(114-8)**, which marriage establishes between one spouse and the kin of the other.: wife's family of origin are in-laws to husband and vice versa. - **114-1** **Descent**, n. - **descendant**, n.: one linked through descent - **114-2** **Ancestor**, n. - **ancestral**, adj. - **114-3** **Relative**, n. - **related**, adj. - **relationship**, n.: the state of being related. The term relative is used for persons related by blood or marriage.
**Kin**, n. and adj. - **kinship**, n.: the state of being kin. **Relatives** is sometimes also used for the collection of all kin. - **114-7** **Progeny**, n.: this term may also be used for all of the descendants of a common ancestor. - **114-8** In certain countries persons related by marriage may be referred to as **in-laws**
ctx_en.en:11:
The **family** **(115-1)** (cf. 112-1) as a unit in demographic studies representing all or part of a *household* (110-3) needs to be specifically defined, and definitions for different purposes may vary. A **statistical family** **(115-1)** or **census family** **(115-1)** generally consists of all members of a household who are related through blood, adoption or marriage. A household may, or may not include a family. A statistical family cannot comprise more than one household, although a household may include more than one family. In some countries the definition of a statistical family may approximate to the *biological family* (113-1); in others the definition may be based on the **family nucleus** **(115-2)** consisting of either a married couple without children, a married couple with one or more never-married children or one parent with one or more never-married children. These may either form the census family itself or be the core of such a family. Married couples living with their biological children are called intact or sometimes **traditional families** **(115-3)**.  By contrast, a **broken family** **(115-4)** is one in which one of the parents has been lost by death, divorce, separation or desertion. Families where one parent, separated or widowed, lives with her children may be also be named **single parent families** **(115-4)**. Married couples, widowed or separated people who, at the time of the declaration, have no more children living in the household, may have special name, like in Germany, **residual family (“Restfamilie”)** **(115-5)**. When these types of families are living within a household, they are called **family household** **(115-6)**.
 - **115-1**  In the United States of America, a **sub-family** is a married couple with or without children, or a parent with one or more never-married children, under 18 years of age, living as members of a household and related to but not including the head of the household and his wife. In Great Britain, the **primary family unit** consists of parents and their children, the parents' sibs and ancestors.
ctx_en.en:12:
In demographic literature, the term **generation** **(116-1)** has been given a precise meaning and refers to a group of persons born within a specified period of time, generally taken as a calendar year. The term **cohort** **(116-2)** denotes a group of persons who experience a certain event in a specified period of time: thus birth cohort is a synonym for generation in the sense of 116-1, a marriage cohort is a group of persons married within a defined period, etc. In demography as in genealogy the term **generation** **(116-3)** may also be used to denote the descendants of a group of persons who are themselves a generation in the sense of 116-1. Thus the children of a group of migrants are often referred to as the **second generation** **(116-9)**. Occasionally we also use the expression *third or fourth generation*. Generations can be qualified according to their current age as, for example, the **young and rising generation** **(116-6)**, the **middle-aged generation** **(116-7)** or the **generation in the prime of life** **(116-7)** and the **older generation** **(116-8)** while the age limits are often vague and therefore require clarification. Cohorts of people born during historical periods related to low birth rates (or high) can be referred as birth-dearth or **low-birth-rate cohorts** **(116-11)** (or **high-birth-rate cohorts** **(116-10)**--more colloquially baby-boomers). Occasionally consideration is restricted to lines of descent through one sex only, thus a **male generation** **(116-4)** or **paternal generation** **(116-4)** are the sons of a generation of males, a **female generation** **(116-5)** or **maternal generation** **(116-5)** the daughters of a generation of females. These distinctions are normally used when the length of a generation or *mean interval between successive generations* is calculated. (cf. 713-1). - **116-2** **Cohort**, n.: the term cohort analysis is used to denote a method of analyzing data, in which the experience of individual cohorts is studied throughout their lives, or other specified periods.
For purposes of military service the number of men who become liable to conscription in a given year is sometimes called the **class** of that year. In the United States the same term is used for a group of students who complete their studies at a particular school or university in a particular year. - **116-11** Because of the depletion of births during the First World war, particularly in France, the French term “**classes creuses**” is sometimes used in the literature.
ctx_en.en:13:
A **dwelling** **(120-1)**, a **dwelling unit** **(120-1)**, or **living quarters** **(120-1)** are statistical abstractions denoting housing accommodations appropriate for occupation by one household (110-3). The size of a dwelling is measured by the number of its **rooms** **(120-2)** or by its **surface area** **(120-3)**. The **degree of crowding** **(120-4)** is a function of the size of the dwelling and the number of its inhabitants. Crowding standards are applied to distinguish **overcrowded dwellings** **(120-5)** and **insufficiently occupied dwellings** **(120-6)** . An **unoccupied dwelling** **(120-7)** is a dwelling which is not used for residence either permanently or occasionally.
 - **120-1**  A dwelling may consist of a **private house**, or part thereof, or a **flat** or an apartment which forms part of a **block of flats** or **tenement house**. In the United States of America a distinction is made between a **one-household structure** and a **multiple-household structure**, and all persons who are not members of households are regarded as living in **group quarters**. Statistics of houses by the number of **floors** or stories are sometimes provided. It should be noted that in Europe, the **ground floor** is not generally counted, whereas in the United States of America it is called the **first floor**.
